closest.title: Sales Engineer - APAC
closest.text:
Agilysys delivers state-of-the-art software and services built exclusively for hospitality, helping organizations go beyond traditional property management (PMS), point-of-sale (POS), and food and beverage inventory and procurement systems. Its best-in-class solutions operate independently or as a unified ecosystem that connects data and workflows across an operation, property or enterprise. Powered by intelligent guest profiles, data-driven capabilities, and embedded artificial intelligence (AI), Agilysys is architected on a unified data model with a single set of APIs that create shared operational memory across all systems, enabling guest-specific insights to be acted on in real time at any touchpoint. Agilysys delivers advantage through pace and integration, transforming hospitality technology from a system of record into a system of action that accelerates innovation and the rapid delivery of new capabilities. Agilysys serves a 100% hospitality customer base, including hotels and resorts, casinos, cruise lines, corporate and campus dining, healthcare, senior living, and entertainment venues worldwide. www.agilysys.com   

The Role:

As the Sales Engineer – APAC, you'll be at the forefront of digital innovation in one of the most dynamic regions for hospitality growth.  Equipped with an intimate knowledge of hotel management and operations, you will be a key pre-sales technical expert working in close partnership with the regional Sales team. You will play a critical role in driving revenue by delivering compelling product demonstrations, translating complex customer requirements into actionable solution proposals, providing strategic guidance on Agilysys technologies and integration capabilities and helping shape how some of the world’s top hospitality brands deliver unforgettable guest experiences

This is a high-impact, customer-facing role that blends deep product knowledge, solution architecture, and consultative selling skills. You will work across all phases of the sales cycle — from discovery and qualification through solution design, proposal development, and handover to implementation.

Key Responsibilities: 

Pre-Sales Engagement

  • Partner with Sales Directors to understand client business needs, use cases, and key decision drivers.
  • Conduct detailed discovery sessions with customers and stakeholders to map out solution fit.
  • Design and articulate comprehensive technical solutions using the full Agilysys suite, with a focus on hotel PMS, Spa & Golf.
  • Respond to RFPs/RFIs with detailed, technically sound submissions that meet customer requirements.
  • Draft Statements of Work (SOW), architectural diagrams, integration plans, and supporting documentation.

Product Demonstration & Technical Consultation

  • Deliver tailored, high-impact product demonstrations (both virtual and onsite) to decision-makers at all levels — from IT and operations to C-suite executives.
  • Maintain a full working demonstration environment including the latest Agilysys releases and configurations.
  • Educate customers on the value proposition of Agilysys solutions, focusing on ROI, scalability, and guest experience enhancement.

Industry Expertise & Solution Evangelism

  • Act as a trusted advisor to clients and partners on hospitality technology trends and digital transformation.
  • Represent Agilysys at industry events, conferences, webinars, and trade shows.
  • Provide market feedback to Product and R&D teams, helping shape the product roadmap based on APAC customer needs.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with internal teams across Product Management, Engineering, Professional Services, and Support to ensure proposed solutions are technically feasible and aligned with delivery capabilities.
  • Support handoff to the implementation team post-deal close, ensuring smooth knowledge transfer and alignment.


Other duties as required

Requirements for success:

Experience & Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in hospitality or Hotel Management, or related field preferred.
  • Prior experience in a Sales Engineering, Solution Consultant, or Solution Architect role in enterprise software, ideally in hospitality or adjacent industries.
  • Prior experience working with boutique, large and/or multi-property hotel brands across APAC.

Technical & Domain Expertise

  • Strong working knowledge of hotel systems including PMS, POS, I&P, Spa, Loyalty, and payment gateways.
  • Understanding of enterprise software concepts such as APIs, relational databases, networking, security, and SaaS/cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience with hospitality integrations (e.g., CRS, OTA, third-party systems) and standard data exchange protocols.

Skills & Attributes

  • Outstanding presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Analytical mindset with a strong ability to translate business needs into technical solutions.
  • Customer-first mindset, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Self-motivated, resourceful, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, matrixed global environment.
  • Fluency in English required; additional APAC languages (e.g., Mandarin, Japanese, Bahasa) a strong advantage.

Other Requirements

  • Willing and able to travel up to 75% across the APAC region.
  • Prior experience working in multicultural environments and navigating complex sales cycles across diverse markets.

About AiDASH

AiDASH is leading the PreventionFirst™movement for electric utilities and transforming grid resilience through its pioneering platform that unifies vegetation, asset, storm, and wildfire intelligence. Powered by SatelliteFirst™ Inspection & Monitoring, AiDASH delivers comprehensive visibility across the entire grid at the right frequency and budget, using the right data modality. More than 200 customers trust AiDASH to keep the lights on, spend where it counts, and defend every decision, Securing Tomorrow across every mile of the grid. Learn more at www.aidash.com.

The PreventionFirst movement is growing, and so is the recognition behind it. In 2026, Forbes named AiDASH one of America's Best Startup Employers for the 4th consecutive year, and TIME included AiDASH among America's Top GreenTech Companies for the 3rd year in a row. Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ ranked AiDASH No. 12 in the San Francisco Bay Area, and No. 59 overall in their selection of the top 500 for 2024. 

Join us in Securing Tomorrow Together! 

The Role 

Our Application Engineering team is where the AiDASH platform meets the real-world needs of enterprise customers. We take the core product and tailor it to each customer’s workflows, systems, and data – building extensions on top of core product APIs, integrations with customer and partner systems, and bespoke capabilities that large utilities (especially Investor-Owned Utilities) depend on. It is hands-on, customer-facing engineering with direct, measurable impact. 

As a software engineer III, you will bring deep full-stack expertise and a strong sense of ownership to high-impact, customer-facing work. With a roster of integrations on the near-term horizon, you will lead the design and delivery of complex solutions that bridge the gap between our core product and the specific demands of the market, mentor other engineers, and act as a technical authority within the team. You will work closely with customers and partners to translate ambiguous requirements into production-grade software. 

How You’ll Make an Impact 

  • Lead complex customer solutions: Architect and deliver sophisticated integrations, migrations, and platform extensions — built on core product APIs — that address unique enterprise workflows, owning the work from technical scoping through production deployment. 
  • Bridge product and market: Close the gap between the core platform and the bespoke requirements of large customers, especially Investor-Owned Utilities, balancing reusable, product-aligned design against customer-specific needs. 
  • Partner with customers directly: Engage customers and external partners on upcoming integrations — scoping requirements, presenting trade-offs, and building trust as the technical face of AiDASH. 
  • Drive full-stack excellence: Work authoritatively across the stack — backend (Python, Java) and frontend (React with TypeScript) — making sound architectural decisions that balance speed, scalability, and maintainability. 
  • Build AI-native: Use AI tooling — from AI-assisted coding such as Cursor and Claude to agentic workflows and services like AWS Bedrock — to ship faster and raise quality, and help establish how the team works with these tools. 
  • Own technical architecture: Lead schema design, data modelling, and query optimisation across SQL and NoSQL databases for complex, high-volume customer environments. 
  • Set the engineering bar: Champion best practices in code quality, testing, documentation, and system design; conduct thorough code reviews and mentor junior engineers. 
  • Communicate with clarity: Present technical decisions and trade-offs clearly to both engineering and non-technical stakeholders at all levels, working in an Agile/Scrum environment with JIRA. 

What We’re Looking For 

  • 6+ years of professional experience delivering full-stack web applications in production. 
  • Deep expertise in Python or Java for backend development, and React with TypeScript on the frontend. 
  • Strong command of SQL and NoSQL databases — including schema design, query optimisation, and data pipeline architecture. 
  • Proven ability to architect and deliver scalable, maintainable, well-tested systems end to end. 
  • Experience building API-based extensions and integrating with third-party or partner systems. 
  • Fluency with AI-assisted development — AI coding assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude) and/or agentic workflows and services such as AWS Bedrock — and good judgement about where they add value. 
  • Experience in B2B SaaS or enterprise software, ideally with customer-facing or professional services exposure; comfort working directly with customers and partners. 
  • Comfortable in an Agile/Scrum environment using JIRA. 
  • A degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 

Nice to Have

closestEng.text: At Alcon, we're passionate about enhancing sight and helping people see brilliantly. With more than 25,000 associates, we innovate fearlessly, champion progress, and act swiftly to impact global eye health. We foster an inclusive culture, recognizing your contributions and offering opportunities to grow your career like never before. Together, we make a difference in the lives of our patients and customers. Are you ready to join us?​ Job profile summary Responsible for designing, developing, and implementing new or revised production processes for the efficient/economical mass production of goods including: Designing arrangement of manufacturing equipment to ensure most efficient and productive layout Designing the sequence of production operations, specifying procedures for the fabrication of applicable tools and equipment, and adapting machinery in response to factory conditions Conducting tests throughout all stages of production to determine control over applicable variables and troubleshooting/solving production problems Providing guidance and inputs to product design engineering on technical specifications that will best utilize equipment and manufacturing techniques. Ensuring that production processes and procedures are in compliance with regulations. Responsible for supporting optical assembly processes, including proper handling and cleaning techniques of optical components to maintain high-quality standards. The role requires familiarity with optical adhesives and a basic understanding of bonding chemistry to ensure effective and reliable assembly. Knowledge of optical systems, optical measurements and optical system performance. Requires understanding of compliance, pharmaceutical, biological, biochemical, medical, patent and commercial factors. Make recommendations concerning acquisition and use of new technological equipment and materials; develop and inform new product design or current product upgrades to ensure manufacturability and assembly; support investigations by providing technical reports for use by regulatory agencies/bodies. Min bachelor's degree in engineering, automation ect related discipline 5-10 years NPI engineer, process engineer experience in MTO, prefer in start-ups, relevant experience in highly regulated industry with complex product lines. Optics most preferred. Strong Mechanical, chemical, process, optics background, with strong problem-solving skills. Hands-on approach with a strong ability to work directly on equipment and processes. Self-starter who can work independently and take initiative in problem-solving and process improvement. Commitment to compliance , safety, and continuous improvement. Strong communication and ability to work collaboratively in a team environment Ability to learn quickly and adapt to changing environments Commitment to high-quality work and continuous improvement Positive attitude and willingness to take on new challenges Why join Alcon? - Join a global leader with a rich history of innovation and excellence in eye care. - Be part of a collaborative and supportive team culture that values diversity and inclusion. - Enjoy a competitive compensation package and opportunities for career advancement. - Make a meaningful difference in the lives of patients worldwide by contributing to cutting-edge advancements in eye health. matches.title: Cloud Support Engineer
matches.text:
About AlphaSense: 

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

About the Team

Customer & Product Support (C&PS) sits at the intersection of sales, customer success and R&D teams. Through close teamwork and collaboration, we drive positive customer outcomes and ensure seamless access and optimal utilization of AlphaSense’s market-leading platform and products. We are committed to enhancing every user’s experience through consistent delivery of prompt and knowledgeable responses. The Customer & Product Support team is based globally across the US, Canada, UK, India and Singapore.

About the Role

We are looking for a proactive Cloud Support Engineer to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will own technical problems end-to-end within your scope including investigating, diagnosing and resolving customer issues across SaaS and private cloud environments. In your role day-to-day, you will collaborate closely with senior engineers and technical customer contacts on more complex cases.

You will be the second line of defense for technical queries, working at the intersection of customers, frontline support and Engineering. This is a strong foundation role for someone early in their cloud support career with some experience, who has demonstrated relevant technical skills, contributing to a high-trust team and the ability to apply AI tools to scale their impact.

Growth paths from this role include progression with the Support function to Senior Cloud Support Engineer and beyond, or a move into our Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team, supported by structured training and collaboration with Engineering.

Who You Are

  • A technically curious engineer with 2 - 4 years in technical support, IT operations, cloud operations or a related field.

  • A clear communicator in writing and on customer calls, with the ability to explain technical concepts with appropriate clarity.

  • A problem-solver with a proactive, customer-first mindset and an eye for surfacing risks early.

  • Adaptable, eager to continuously learn, and willing to ask for help when blocked.

  • Energized by being part of an entrepreneurial team and willing to pull your own weight to help the team succeed.

What You’ll Do

  • Deliver exceptional technical support: Act as the second line of defense for technical queries, ensuring timely and effective resolution of customer issues through close collaboration between L1 support and R&D teams. Own the customer-facing loop on your assigned tickets, driving them to resolution with urgency.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical challenges: Diagnose issues using logs, traces, and reproducible test cases; work confidently with kubectl, awscli, and at least one scripting language. Resolve in-scope issues completely and escalate out-of-scope issues to the correct engineering domain with high-quality artifacts.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner effectively within the team and across regions and time zones; share knowledge proactively and close loops on commitments. Build working relationships with both account teams and R&D as you grow your technical credibility.

  • Documentation: Contribute to runbooks, KEDB articles, and FAQs. Maintain documentation hygiene on the issues you own.

  • Be an advocate for customers: Represent the voice of the customer in internal discussions and initiatives to maximize the value of our platform and products.

  • Build working knowledge of the AlphaSense platform and core products. Identify your own knowledge gaps and build a plan to close them.

  • Use AI tools in your daily work for technical investigations, log analysis, customer communication and documentation. Build repeatable prompts and workflows rather than one-off use; share what works with the team.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

  • 2 - 4 years in technical support, IT operations, cloud operations or a related field.

  • Working proficiency with CLI tools (e.g., kubectl, awscli) and scripting skills in Python, JavaScript or similar.

  • Working knowledge of GraphQL, REST APIs and MCP-related troubleshooting.

  • Familiarity with connecting LLMs to external tools, including multi-agent systems.

  • Exposure to alerting and logging systems (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, FireHydrant).

  • Demonstrated AI fluency in day-to-day work: can speak to examples of how AI has changed the way they work.

  • Experience managing customer support cases through their lifecycle from inquiry, triage, bug reporting, through to resolution.

  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to customers and team members.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in networking and troubleshooting complex network issues

  • Experience troubleshooting in at least one major cloud platform (preferably AWS) and containerized environments using Kubernetes or Docker.

  • Extensive experience working with GraphQL and other web APIs

  • Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code tools, such as Crossplane, and related troubleshooting 

  • Experience with Search Technologies and Data Storages (e.g. Vespa, ElasticSearch, MongoDB, MySQL)

  • Experience or familiarity with the Java programming language

  • Experience with standard software release lifecycles.

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

  • AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.
  • All official communications will come from an @alpha-sense.com email address.
  • If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

We are committed to enhancing every user’s experience through consistent delivery of prompt and knowledgeable responses. The Customer & Product Support team is based globally across the US, Canada, UK, India and Singapore.

About the Role

We are looking for a proactive Cloud Support Engineer to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will own technical problems end-to-end within your scope including investigating, diagnosing and resolving customer issues across SaaS and private cloud environments. In your role day-to-day, you will collaborate closely with senior engineers and technical customer contacts on more complex cases.

You will be the second line of defense for technical queries, working at the intersection of customers, frontline support and Engineering. This is a strong foundation role for someone early in their cloud support career with some experience, who has demonstrated relevant technical skills, contributing to a high-trust team and the ability to apply AI tools to scale their impact.

Growth paths from this role include progression with the Support function to Senior Cloud Support Engineer and beyond, or a move into our Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team, supported by structured training and collaboration with Engineering.

Who You Are

  • A technically curious engineer with 2 - 4 years in technical support, IT operations, cloud operations or a related field.

  • A clear communicator in writing and on customer calls, with the ability to explain technical concepts with appropriate clarity.

  • A problem-solver with a proactive, customer-first mindset and an eye for surfacing risks early.

  • Adaptable, eager to continuously learn, and willing to ask for help when blocked.

  • Energized by being part of an entrepreneurial team and willing to pull your own weight to help the team succeed.

What You’ll Do

  • Deliver exceptional technical support: Act as the second line of defense for technical queries, ensuring timely and effective resolution of customer issues through close collaboration between L1 support and R&D teams. Own the customer-facing loop on your assigned tickets, driving them to resolution with urgency.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical challenges: Diagnose issues using logs, traces, and reproducible test cases; work confidently with kubectl, awscli, and at least one scripting language. Resolve in-scope issues completely and escalate out-of-scope issues to the correct engineering domain with high-quality artifacts.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner effectively within the team and across regions and time zones; share knowledge proactively and close loops on commitments. Build working relationships with both account teams and R&D as you grow your technical credibility.

  • Documentation: Contribute to runbooks, KEDB articles, and FAQs. Maintain documentation hygiene on the issues you own.

  • Be an advocate for customers: Represent the voice of the customer in internal discussions and initiatives to maximize the value of our platform and products.

  • Build working knowledge of the AlphaSense platform and core products. Identify your own knowledge gaps and build a plan to close them.

  • Use AI tools in your daily work for technical investigations, log analysis, customer communication and documentation. Build repeatable prompts and workflows rather than one-off use; share what works with the team.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

  • 2 - 4 years in technical support, IT operations, cloud operations or a related field.

  • Working proficiency with CLI tools (e.g., kubectl, awscli) and scripting skills in Python, JavaScript or similar.

  • Working knowledge of GraphQL, REST APIs and MCP-related troubleshooting.

  • Familiarity with connecting LLMs to external tools, including multi-agent systems.

  • Exposure to alerting and logging systems (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, FireHydrant).

  • Demonstrated AI fluency in day-to-day work: can speak to examples of how AI has changed the way they work.

  • Experience managing customer support cases through their lifecycle from inquiry, triage, bug reporting, through to resolution.

  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to customers and team members.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in networking and troubleshooting complex network issues

  • Experience troubleshooting in at least one major cloud platform (preferably AWS) and containerized environments using Kubernetes or Docker.

  • Extensive experience working with GraphQL and other web APIs

  • Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code tools, such as Crossplane, and related troubleshooting 

  • Experience with Search Technologies and Data Storages (e.g. Vespa, ElasticSearch, MongoDB, MySQL)

  • Experience or familiarity with the Java programming language

  • Experience with standard software release lifecycles.

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

closest.text: Intro Are you ready to explore a world of possibilities, both at work and during your time off? Join our American Airlines family, and you’ll travel the world, grow your expertise and become the best version of you. As you embark on a new journey, you’ll tackle challenges with flexibility and grace, learning new skills and advancing your career while having the time of your life. Feel free to enrich both your personal and work life and hop on board! Why you'll love this job This job is a member of the Generative AI Product Team within the Information Technology Division. In this role you will lead the vision and strategy for the effective use of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning technologies to drive organizational growth, innovation, and competitive advantage. You will work on pioneering projects that harness the power of artificial intelligence to solve complex problems and create significant business value. Our innovative and collaborative environment encourages creativity, continuous learning, and professional growth. You'll have the opportunity to work with a diverse team of experts, leveraging cutting-edge technologies to build scalable and impactful AI solutions. closest.title: Associate IS Security Engineer
closest.text: Career Category Information Systems Job Description ABOUT AMGEN Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases, and make people’s lives easier, fuller and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what’s known today. ABOUT THE ROLE Role Description: The role supports the implementation and operation of the organization's information security strategy to help protect data, systems, and networks from potential threats. This role assists with implementing and maintaining network security technologies and controls to help ensure that systems, applications, and networks are protected against evolving cyber risks. Working closely with IT, infrastructure, application, and security teams, the Associate Information Security Engineer helps integrate security into technology solutions and operational processes. The role participates in day-to-day network security operations, supports risk management activities, and helps ensure compliance with applicable security policies, standards, and regulatory requirements. The ideal candidate has strong communication and analytical skills, a solid understanding of cybersecurity and networking fundamentals, and a desire to learn and grow within a collaborative enterprise security team. Roles & Responsibilities: Deploy, configure, and maintain security tools such as firewalls, IDS/IPS, WAF, DMARC, DNS, and VPN Assist in reviewing and implementing security configurations in accordance with enterprise standards Support the implementation of enterprise network security solutions and related technical documentation Participate in evaluating security technologies and contribute recommendations under guidance Develop technical expertise in network security technologies while collaborating with senior engineers and cross-functional teams Network Security Engineer Create, modify, and remove security policies and objects within the network security toolset (Fortinet UTM, WAF, DMARC, and Netskope ZTNA) in a manner to protect Amgen’s computerized network, while providing access to enable business systems and processes Troubleshoot technical issues that are related to Network Security offerings Administer Enterprise Restricted Browser (Island.io) by working with Partner Enablement team to identify and grant required access to business enabling services across Amgen’s services Develop scripts (e.g., Python, Fortinet Security Fabric) and build automation solutions, including AI-assisted workflows, to improve network security operations and operational efficiency Build and present knowledge sharing presentations and documentation to educate staff on network security processes Assist with evaluating, onboarding, and implementing security tools to help protect Amgen's enterprise network environment Assist in providing remediation guidance for identified security issues Draft network security policies, standards and guidance documentation Basic Qualifications and Experience: Any degree with 2 - 6 years of experience in network or network security or related field Functional Skills: Must-Have Skills: Working knowledge of enterprise network operations, firewall operations, intrusion detection & prevention, web proxy, and IPSec/SSL-VPN/ZTNA Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot enterprise network security solutions Experience creating technical documentation using Lucidchart, Visio, or similar diagramming tools Familiarity with enterprise change management processes using ServiceNow, Remedy, or similar platforms Good-to-Have Skills: Experience using and administering Fortinet product solutions including FortiGate, FortiWeb, FortiAnalyzer, FortiManager, FortiADC, and FortiAuthenticator Experience with Netskope security product offering including Next Generation Secure Web Gateway (SWG), Private Access, Cloud Firewall, and SkopeAI Experience with endpoint protection, cloud security, and incident response Experience with DMARC email reputation security using Valimail Experience using InfoBlox IPAM Experience with AWS, Azure, and GCP clouds Professional Certifications : NSE 4 (preferred) Netskope Security Cloud Operation and Administration (preferred) NSE 5 FortiManager (preferred) NSE 5 FortiAnalyzer (preferred) CCNA (preferred) CompTIA Security+ (preferred) Soft Skills: Strong English verbal and written communication skills Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills Ability to work effectively with global, virtual teams High degree of initiative and self-motivation Ability to manage multiple priorities successfully Team oriented, with a focus on achieving team goals EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer and will consider you without regard to your race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability status. .

closest.text: Come join Analog Devices (ADI) – a place where Innovation meets Impact. For more than 55 years, Analog Devices has been inventing new breakthrough technologies that transform lives. At ADI you will work alongside the brightest minds to collaborate on solving complex problems that matter from autonomous vehicles, drones and factories to augmented reality and remote healthcare. ADI fosters a culture that focuses on employees through beneficial programs, aligned goals, continuous learning opportunities, and practices that create a more sustainable future. About Analog Devices Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X . The Test Product Engineer (TPE) is responsible for supporting manufacturing by ensuring continuous production, maintaining test hardware and systems, and driving improvements in quality, yield, cycle time, and cost. The role involves troubleshooting and root cause analysis of test-related issues, implementing improvement initiatives, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to meet production and business objectives. The TPE also contributes to workforce development, project execution, and documentation to support efficient and reliable manufacturing operations. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities The TPE must possess the following skills: Has good knowledge of Basic Electronics, Engineering Practices, and Procedures. Knowledge in Wafer and IC Package Level testing or expertise in one of these areas is an advantage but not required. Knowledgeable in software programming and hardware architecture. Knowledgeable in Maxim’s commonly used production handler and wafer probe machines. Has the ability to recruit and hire entry-level personnel for test production engineering positions. Must have good oral and written communication skills. Demonstrate root cause analysis skills. Job Responsibilities 1. Test Production Engineering Support in Manufacturing Ensure continuous production of products under his/her group’s responsibility Ensure that hardware and KGU is well maintained, and all product test setup requirements are well documented Improve product test performance in manufacturing Improve QA PPM level and yield outliers in manufacturing 2. Quality Improvement Initiate, drive and monitor QA PPM related projects, and ensure project completion in a timely manner Ensure QA failure-related issues are addressed immediately 3. Yield Improvement Ensure yield-related issues are addressed immediately Initiate, drive and monitor Yield Improvement projects, and ensure project completion in a timely manner 4. Cycle Time Reduction Initiate, drive and monitor Single Pass Flow Evaluations and ensure project completion in a timely manner Initiate, drive and monitor Test Time Reduction projects and ensure project completion in a timely manner Initiate and drive in releasing and monitoring of hold lots with HW/Interface issues in 2 days 5. Cost Reduction Initiate, drive and monitor Cost Reduction projects and ensure project completion in a timely manner 6. Workforce and Communication Generate quarterly goals and ensure these goals are achieved Attend weekly meetings with the group and counterparts Update and maintain the Project List and submit it to Supervisors for evaluation with respect to prioritization Generate reports periodically as needed Support other groups/departments as needed 7. Training, Special Projects, and Others Key Performance Areas Ensure engineers are competent enough and are certified on certain qualifications Initiate, drive and monitor special projects for the group, and ensure project completion in a timely manner Learn ADI's commonly used production handler and wafer probe machines Perform other duties assigned by the Management Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in Electronics Engineering (ECE), Electrical Engineering (EE), or Computer Engineering (ComEng) 0–2 years of relevant experience For positions requiring access to technical data, Analog Devices, Inc. may have to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce - Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U.S. Department of State - Directorate of Defense Trade Controls. As such, applicants for this position – except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) – may have to go through an export licensing review process. Analog Devices is an equal opportunity employer. We foster a culture where everyone has an opportunity to succeed regardless of their race, color, religion, age, ancestry, national origin, social or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, parental status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, union membership, and political affiliation, or any other legally protected group. Job Req Type: Graduate Job Required Travel: No

matches.title: Engineer I - Full Stack
matches.text:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating our wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

The Role

Anaplan is looking for a Engineer I to join our Experience Engineering workstream.

You will be a founding member of a new team dedicated to building our world-class user experience. You will work alongside talented engineers to build and ship award-winning planning technology that helps people and companies around the world make better-informed plans and decisions.

We are looking for an engineer with a passion for learning who believes in simplicity, agility, and performance. In this role, you will develop systems, build tools, and establish best practices that enable Anaplan to deliver a seamless and intuitive experience to our customers.

Your Impact

  • Be part of a well-balanced, cross-functional team delivering exceptional software.

  • Stay customer-focused, solving problems for users and enabling sustainable solutions.

  • Work closely with Product teams to deliver customer-delighting experiences and platform innovations.

  • Actively practice continuous integration and deployment while contributing improvements to engineering processes.

  • Thrive within an agile development environment that promotes autonomy and accountability.

  • Write tests across all levels of the testing pyramid to ensure production-ready quality.

  • Apply your experience across the full stack while continuing to expand your technical expertise.

  • Demonstrate strong attention to detail and a passion for building applications that solve meaningful customer problems.

Your Skills

  • Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to design scalable, maintainable, and well-architected systems.

  • Strong understanding of:

    • JavaScript (ES2015+)

    • HTML

    • CSS

  • Emerging proficiency with:

    • TypeScript

    • React

  • Optional experience building back-end services using JVM-based languages such as:

    • Java

    • Kotlin

    • Spring Boot

  • Understanding of deployment tools and technologies, including:

    • Docker

    • Kubernetes

    • Terraform

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills.

We know great talent comes from a variety of backgrounds, and we encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't perfectly match every qualification listed above.

Languages & Technologies You'll Work With

Front-End

  • React

  • TypeScript

  • CSS

  • Redux

  • Jest

  • Vite

  • Enzyme

  • Cypress

You will be a founding member of a new team dedicated to building our world-class user experience. You will work alongside talented engineers to build and ship award-winning planning technology that helps people and companies around the world make better-informed plans and decisions.

We are looking for an engineer with a passion for learning who believes in simplicity, agility, and performance. In this role, you will develop systems, build tools, and establish best practices that enable Anaplan to deliver a seamless and intuitive experience to our customers.

Your Impact

  • Be part of a well-balanced, cross-functional team delivering exceptional software.

  • Stay customer-focused, solving problems for users and enabling sustainable solutions.

  • Work closely with Product teams to deliver customer-delighting experiences and platform innovations.

  • Actively practice continuous integration and deployment while contributing improvements to engineering processes.

  • Thrive within an agile development environment that promotes autonomy and accountability.

  • Write tests across all levels of the testing pyramid to ensure production-ready quality.

  • Apply your experience across the full stack while continuing to expand your technical expertise.

  • Demonstrate strong attention to detail and a passion for building applications that solve meaningful customer problems.

Your Skills

  • Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to design scalable, maintainable, and well-architected systems.

  • Strong understanding of:

    • JavaScript (ES2015+)

    • HTML

    • CSS

  • Emerging proficiency with:

    • TypeScript

    • React

  • Optional experience building back-end services using JVM-based languages such as:

    • Java

    • Kotlin

    • Spring Boot

  • Understanding of deployment tools and technologies, including:

    • Docker

    • Kubernetes

    • Terraform

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills.

We know great talent comes from a variety of backgrounds, and we encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't perfectly match every qualification listed above.

Languages & Technologies You'll Work With

Front-End

  • React

  • TypeScript

  • CSS

  • Redux

  • Jest

  • Vite

  • Enzyme

  • Cypress

Back-End

  • Java

  • Kotlin

  • Spring Framework

  • MySQL

Infrastructure & DevOps

  • Docker

  • Kubernetes

  • Jenkins

  • Git

  • Helm

What We Offer

  • A role at the heart of Anaplan's global growth strategy.

  • A team that embraces diverse perspectives and encourages innovation.

  • The opportunity to build exceptional software that delights customers and transforms business strategy software.

 

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  

Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer  

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.

Anaplan does not:  

  • Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.  
  • Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.  

All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.  

Candidate data processed during our recruitment activities is handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice. This may include the use of artificial intelligence or automated tools to assist our team in evaluating qualifications.

nearMatches.title: Software Engineer in Test (SET)
nearMatches.text: Job Title: Software Engineer in Test (SET) Function: Quality Engineering / Testing Location: Hyderabad, India Experience: 3–5 Years About Anblicks Anblicks is a cloud data engineering and analytics company enabling enterprises to modernize their data platforms through Cloud, Data Engineering, AI/ML, and Advanced Analytics solutions. We build scalable, secure, and high-performance enterprise systems for global clients. We are looking for a detail-oriented and technically strong Software Engineer in Test (SET) who is passionate about automation and quality engineering. The ideal candidate will combine programming expertise with testing knowledge to build robust automation solutions that ensure high-quality product releases. Role Summary As a Software Engineer in Test (SET), you will design, develop, and execute automated test solutions for enterprise-grade applications. You will work closely with Software Developers and QA engineers within Agile scrum teams to deliver reliable, scalable, and high-quality solutions in a cost-effective and timely manner. This role focuses on building automation frameworks, expanding regression coverage, and developing testing utilities that improve overall engineering quality. You will “write software that tests software.” Key Responsibilities 1. Test Design & Automation Design, develop, and execute comprehensive automation test suites. Create and maintain test plans, test cases, and regression coverage. Expand and enhance existing automation frameworks. Automate newly integrated features and validate end-to-end workflows. 2. Technical Testing & Validation Analyze complex software systems and design functional and performance testing strategies. Develop automated test scripts for UI, API, integration, and backend validation. Write custom testing utilities and tools to support QA and development teams. Execute manual testing when required to validate edge cases and new features. Analyze test results, identify defects, and recommend corrective actions. 3. Agile & Collaboration Work closely with developers and QA engineers in Agile/Scrum teams. Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives. Provide accurate estimations for testing and automation tasks. Track and manage defects using JIRA or similar SDLC tools. Communicate testing progress, risks, and results clearly to stakeholders. 4. Cloud & Multi-Tier Testing Test applications deployed in multi-tier and cloud-based environments. Validate integrations across APIs, databases, and distributed services. Support CI/CD-driven automation and continuous testing practices. Required Qualifications 3–5 years of experience in QA and/or software development. Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as Java, JavaScript, or Python. Experience designing and maintaining automated test suites. Solid understanding of: Object-Oriented Design principles Data structures Version control systems (Git-based workflows) Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) Experience with JIRA or other SDLC management tools. Strong analytical and debugging skills. Ability to work effectively in Agile/Scrum environments. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field. Experience testing cloud-native applications (AWS/Azure/GCP). Exposure to API testing tools and performance testing frameworks. Experience integrating automation into CI/CD pipelines. Familiarity with enterprise data platforms or analytics systems. What Will Set You Apart Automation-first mindset with strong coding discipline. Experience working in distributed or microservices architectures. Passion for improving software quality through engineering best practices. Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Ability to learn quickly and adapt to evolving technologies.

closest.title: Senior QA Engineer (Automation)
closest.text:
Job Title -  Senior QA Engineer – Automation
Location - Pune City, India
 
About Anchanto
Build What Powers ECommerce Across Asia.
At Anchanto, we’re on a mission to simplify and scale eCommerce operations for businesses globally. Our SaaS platforms power seamless integrations across marketplaces, logistics providers, and enterprise systems.
With teams across Singapore, India, Southeast Asia, Australia, and beyond, we’re growing fast — and now expanding our Quality Engineering team in Pune City.
Role Overview
We are looking for engineers who have strong analytical, debugging, and troubleshooting capabilities across APIs, integrations, middleware systems, logs, and production environments within fast-paced enterprise SaaS ecosystems.
The ideal candidate should also enjoy solving real-world problems through integrations and automation — connecting systems, validating seamless data movement, and building scalable test frameworks.
The candidate should have 5–8 years of experience in Integration Testing, System Testing, Non-Functional Testing (NFR), and Automation Engineering, along with 1–2 years of test framework development or software development experience using Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Python.
This is a hands-on technical role ideal for someone passionate about building modern automation frameworks (Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, etc.), architecting scalable quality engineering solutions, and driving intelligent automation across enterprise SaaS platforms.
Key Responsibilities
What You Will Do
  • Master the end-to-end business logic of our SaaS platform and translate complex functional requirements (FSDs) into high-fidelity automated test scenarios reflecting real-world customer flows.
  • Enhance and manage test automation suites validating integrations between our SaaS platform and external systems (marketplaces, logistics, ERP).
  • Design and develop automated test scripts validating scalable backend services.
  • Validate APIs and data exchange systems (REST, messaging).
  • Build and scale an automation-first testing suite using Playwright/TypeScript, leveraging AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate automation development and improve engineering productivity.
  • Integrate testing with observability tools (New Relic, Datadog) to analyze production logs and environment data, driving “Shift-Right” validation and simulating actual user behaviors.
  • Implement self-healing mechanisms within the automation repository and lead NFR automation (Performance, Security, API reliability) to ensure production readiness.
  • Own the integration of automated test suites into Jenkins/GitHub Actions pipelines, ensuring quality gates are triggered at every commit to prevent defect leakage.
  • Serve as a technical mentor to junior engineers, upskilling them in AI-prompt engineering and modern “Quality as Code” practices.
  • Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to deliver high-quality solutions.
Required Qualifications
What We Are Looking For
  • Strong analytical, debugging, and troubleshooting capabilities across APIs, integrations, middleware systems, logs, and production environments within enterprise SaaS ecosystems.
  • 5–8 years of experience in Software Quality Engineering for high-scale SaaS products.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Playwright or Cypress (TypeScript/JavaScript) with comfort in architecting distributed test execution.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Integration and End-to-End testing.
  • Experience validating messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.).
  • Strong understanding of API integrations and data formats (JSON, XML).
  • Familiarity with authentication protocols (OAuth2, SAML).
  • Hands-on experience using Generative AI for test data generation, automated PR reviews, and script refactoring.
  • Ability to query and interpret logs from New Relic, Splunk, or Datadog to identify root causes and edge cases.
  • Experience with Performance testing (Playwright / JMeter) and basic Security testing (OWASP Top 10) integrated into automation workflows.
  • Strong SQL skills and deep experience testing RESTful Microservices using automated tools.
  • Ability to work closely with Scrum teams, Product, Engineering, and DevOps teams to align on quality goals and ensure coverage of business-critical workflows.
  • Represent QA in Agile ceremonies and participate in release readiness assessments.
  • Monitor and drive quality metrics such as automation coverage, defect leakage, and test execution health.
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills.
Good to Have
  • Experience in SaaS, e-commerce, or logistics product domains.
  • Experience integrating with platforms such as Amazon, Shopify, or similar.
  • Interest or exposure to AI-assisted development tools.
  • Familiarity with self-healing automation tools and AI/ML-based test optimization.
  • Exposure to containerized environments (Docker/Kubernetes) and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP).
Why Join Anchanto?
  • Work on real, high-impact SaaS products used across global markets.
  • Be part of a fast-growing, AI-powered team.
  • Open, collaborative, and innovation-driven culture.
  • Strong career growth opportunities.
  • Join a team that values ownership, learning, and excellence.

closest.title: Staff Engineer (AVP)
closest.text: About Us At ANZ, we're applying new ways technology and data can be harnessed as we work towards a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers. Our community of over 5,000 engineers is key to making this happen, because technology underpins every part of our business - from delivering tools, apps and services for our customers, to building a bank for the future. About the Role As a Staff Engineer in the NZ Domain, you’ll play a crucial role in driving end‑to‑end technical strategy, design, and delivery for high‑impact platforms and products, operating as a senior individual contributor with broad influence across multiple engineering squads. You will design scalable, resilient, compliant, and cost‑effective systems while elevating engineering standards, managing technical debt and technical risks, and ensuring alignment with enterprise engineering patterns and practices. As the recognised technical authority, you will guide teams on how solutions should be built, mentor and build capability across senior engineers and squads, and partner closely with Product, Security, and Operations to ship business‑critical platforms—drawing on deep engineering mastery, strong systems thinking, and exceptional stakeholder management. Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours. Please note that while this advertisement is for a single role, there are multiple vacancies available for this position. Role Type: Permanent Role Location: Bengaluru Work Hours: General Shift (Hybrid\Blended) What will your day look like? Lead and participate in design discussions, and decision-making forums that influence multiple squads. Provide hands‑on technical leadership, including writing high‑quality code, reviewing critical PRs, and guiding senior engineers through complex problems. Dive deep into system performance, reliability, scalability, and security aspects—identifying risks early and driving systemic improvements. Partner with engineering leads to estimate, plan, sequence, and deliver long-range initiatives across multiple workstreams. Drive technical roadmaps, identify tech debt, and prioritize modernization or platform initiatives with long-term impact. Host and lead technical workshops, knowledge-sharing sessions, and design guilds to uplift engineering maturity. Participate in incident reviews, root cause analysis, and drive remediation for recurring or systemic issues. Communicate regularly with leadership to provide clear updates on progress, risks, and decision trade-offs. Mentor senior and mid-level engineers—multiplying expertise across the engineering org. Ensure compliance standards, data privacy, and secure-by-design principles are woven into every stage of development. Collaborate across teams to balance innovation, reliability, and speed, making high-quality technical decisions that align with business goals. What will you bring? Must have 12+ years of engineering experience with deep design and Tech Lead competency. Expertise in designing high scale, distributed systems, including microservices, event-driven architecture, API platforms, and data-intensive systems. Hands-on proficiency in any backend languages (Java/Kotlin/Go/Node/C#) and strong understanding of cloud-native patterns (containers, messaging, caching). Extensive experience in leading Java development at an enterprise level. Extensive experience working on solution design and API design. Experience in Java development at an enterprise level (Spring Boot, Java 8+, Spring) Extensive experience leading API development and integration (REST/JSON, Kafka, message queues) In depth technical knowledge of database systems (Oracle, SQL Server). Strong experience in public cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), Kubernetes, Terraform/IaC, and modern CI/CD. Solid grounding in observability, SRE principles, incident management, and performance engineering. Knowledge of secure coding, compliance frameworks, and enterprise-grade governance. Provides governance over solution design within the squad to ensure it aligns with the Architect and follows established patterns and best practices. While it is expected that other squad members will also contribute to or complete solution design, in all instances it is expected this role will provide a level of governance. Detailed Description Responsible for ensuring all designs are presented and approved by the relevant Tech Area design forum and Technical Review Forums. Proven ability to influence Design and engineering strategy across multiple teams without formal authority. Experience driving cross-team programs, platform modernization, and technical initiatives with significant business impact. Ability to communicate clearly with senior stakeholders, translate technical decisions into business outcomes, and drive consensus. Strong track record of delivering large, complex, multi-quarter initiatives end-to-end. Capability to break down ambiguous problems into clear, sequenced, achievable plans. Proficiency in balancing speed, quality, security, and cost while driving technical excellence. Ability to proactively identify Design risks, operational gaps, or scaling challenges and drive long-term solutions. A systems thinker who understands failure modes, trade-offs, and how to design for resilience and cost efficiency. Passion for mentoring engineers and raising the technical bar across the team. Advocates for best practices, code quality, and engineering craftsmanship. Values diversity, inclusion, and building psychologically safe engineering environments. So why join us? ANZ is a place where big things happen as we work together to provide banking and financial services across more than 30 markets. With more than 7,500 people, our Bengaluru team is the bank's largest technology, data and operations centre outside Australia. In operation for over 33 years, the centre is critical in delivering the bank's strategy and making an impact for our millions of customers around the world. Our Bengaluru team not only drives the transformation initiatives of the bank, it also drives a culture that makes ANZ a great place to be. We're proud that people feel they can be themselves at ANZ and 90 percent of our people feel they belong. We know our people need different things to be great in their role, so we offer a range of flexible working options, including hybrid work (where the role allows it). Our people also enjoy a range of benefits including access to health and wellbeing services. We want to continue building a diverse workplace and welcome applications from everyone. Please talk to us about any adjustments you may require to our recruitment process or the role itself. If you are a candidate with a disability or access requirements, let us know how we can provide you with additional support. To find out more about working at ANZ visit https://www.anz.com/careers/ . You can apply for this role by visiting ANZ Careers and searching for reference number 121080 . Job Posting End Date 10/08/2026, 11.59pm, (Melbourne Australia)

Communicate regularly with leadership to provide clear updates on progress, risks, and decision trade-offs. Mentor senior and mid-level engineers—multiplying expertise across the engineering org. Ensure compliance standards, data privacy, and secure-by-design principles are woven into every stage of development. Collaborate across teams to balance innovation, reliability, and speed, making high-quality technical decisions that align with business goals. What will you bring? Must have 12+ years of engineering experience with deep design and Tech Lead competency. Expertise in designing high scale, distributed systems, including microservices, event-driven architecture, API platforms, and data-intensive systems. Hands-on proficiency in any backend languages (Java/Kotlin/Go/Node/C#) and strong understanding of cloud-native patterns (containers, messaging, caching). Extensive experience in leading Java development at an enterprise level. Extensive experience working on solution design and API design. Experience in Java development at an enterprise level (Spring Boot, Java 8+, Spring) Extensive experience leading API development and integration (REST/JSON, Kafka, message queues) In depth technical knowledge of database systems (Oracle, SQL Server). Strong experience in public cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), Kubernetes, Terraform/IaC, and modern CI/CD. Solid grounding in observability, SRE principles, incident management, and performance engineering. Knowledge of secure coding, compliance frameworks, and enterprise-grade governance. Provides governance over solution design within the squad to ensure it aligns with the Architect and follows established patterns and best practices. While it is expected that other squad members will also contribute to or complete solution design, in all instances it is expected this role will provide a level of governance. Detailed Description Responsible for ensuring all designs are presented and approved by the relevant Tech Area design forum and Technical Review Forums. Proven ability to influence Design and engineering strategy across multiple teams without formal authority. Experience driving cross-team programs, platform modernization, and technical initiatives with significant business impact. Ability to communicate clearly with senior stakeholders, translate technical decisions into business outcomes, and drive consensus. Strong track record of delivering large, complex, multi-quarter initiatives end-to-end. Capability to break down ambiguous problems into clear, sequenced, achievable plans. Proficiency in balancing speed, quality, security, and cost while driving technical excellence. Ability to proactively identify Design risks, operational gaps, or scaling challenges and drive long-term solutions. A systems thinker who understands failure modes, trade-offs, and how to design for resilience and cost efficiency. Passion for mentoring engineers and raising the technical bar across the team. Advocates for best practices, code quality, and engineering craftsmanship. Values diversity, inclusion, and building psychologically safe engineering environments. So why join us? ANZ is a place where big things happen as we work together to provide banking and financial services across more than 30 markets. With more than 7,500 people, our Bengaluru team is the bank's largest technology, data and operations centre outside Australia. In operation for over 33 years, the centre is critical in delivering the bank's strategy and making an impact for our millions of customers around the world. Our Bengaluru team not only drives the transformation initiatives of the bank, it also drives a culture that makes ANZ a great place to be. We're proud that people feel they can be themselves at ANZ and 90 percent of our people feel they belong. We know our people need different things to be great in their role, so we offer a range of flexible working options, including hybrid work (where the role allows it). Our people also enjoy a range of benefits including access to health and wellbeing services. We want to continue building a diverse workplace and welcome applications from everyone. Please talk to us about any adjustments you may require to our recruitment process or the role itself. If you are a candidate with a disability or access requirements, let us know how we can provide you with additional support. To find out more about working at ANZ visit https://www.anz.com/careers/ . You can apply for this role by visiting ANZ Careers and searching for reference number 121080 . Job Posting End Date 10/08/2026, 11.59pm, (Melbourne Australia)

This requires the ability to develop and support applications using Sales Cloud, Lightning Platform, APEX, Visual Force, Chatter and the Force.com platform Requirements:: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, MIS/CIS or equivalent work experience. 7+ years of Salesforce.com development experience. closest.text:
Company Overview

Arcesium is a global financial technology firm that solves complex data-driven challenges faced by some of the world’s most sophisticated financial institutions. We constantly innovate our platform and capabilities to meet tomorrow’s challenges, anticipate the risks our clients encounter, and design advanced solutions to help our clients achieve transformational business outcomes.   

Financial technology is a high-growth industry as change and innovation continue to disrupt the status-quo and prompt major transformation. Arcesium is at a particularly interesting time in our own growth as we look to leverage our successfully established market position and expand operations in pursuit of strategic new business opportunities. We value intellectual curiosity, proactive ownership, and collaboration with colleagues, and we empower you to meaningfully contribute from day one and accelerate your professional development.

We are looking for an exceptionally talented resource to join one of our cross-functional product teams for an individual contributor role. This product team is responsible for building the core accounting product offering of our platform. This position offers the opportunity to define and design the next generation of products on our platform, which is used by some of the most sophisticated hedge funds in the world, and to collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry.

What You'll Do:

  • Carry the product/feature from concept to creation.
  • Brainstorm product/feature ideas and their value proposition to our client base.
  • Distill the vision into documents such as product roadmap and product/feature specifications via deep dives into the domain, gathering requirements and/or business analysis.
  • Work closely with engineers/architects to translate the product specification to design, and then to the product itself.
  • Prepare comprehensive business test cases/beds to aid the engineering process.
  • Rigorously and continuously evaluate the progress of product/feature-in-flight by leveraging the created test cases/beds and ensure compliance to the product/feature specification and the vision.
  • Prepare prototypes using Python and AI.
  • Track and question risks/assumptions.
  • Proactively escalate issues and mitigate execution risks.
  • Conduct competitor analysis.

What You'll Need:

  • 4+ years of experience working in the front, middle, and/or back-office space with a minimum of 2+ years of experience in product management.
  • Technical skills:
    • Understanding of Java: familiarity with Java concepts to effectively communicate and collaborate with the development team.
    • Knowledge of distributed systems: understanding of distributed systems concepts to grasp project requirements and challenges.
    • Database awareness: general knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases to contribute effectively to data-related discussions.
  • Experience working closely with engineers.
  • Outstanding academic background and passion to work in a high-tech software development environment.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
  • Critical thinking and the ability to articulate standpoints/ideas and influence stakeholders.
  • Ability to multitask and manage multiple lines of execution with attention to detail and quality.
  • A healthy combination of resourcefulness, domain expertise, creativity, and execution prowess.
  • Graduate degree in software engineering.
  • Advanced knowledge in trade accounting and operations, or certifications in the financial domain such as MBA or CFA, will be an added advantage.
  • Hands-on experience using and integrating various AI tools for building products will be an added advantage.

closestEng.text:
Company Overview

Arcesium is a global financial technology firm that solves complex data-driven challenges faced by some of the world’s most sophisticated financial institutions. We constantly innovate our platform and capabilities to meet tomorrow’s challenges, anticipate the risks our clients encounter, and design advanced solutions to help our clients achieve transformational business outcomes.   

Financial technology is a high-growth industry as change and innovation continue to disrupt the status-quo and prompt major transformation. Arcesium is at a particularly interesting time in our own growth as we look to leverage our successfully established market position and expand operations in pursuit of strategic new business opportunities. We value intellectual curiosity, proactive ownership, and collaboration with colleagues, and we empower you to meaningfully contribute from day one and accelerate your professional development.

Position Summary

Arcesium seeks an accomplished Senior Software Engineer to join our Infrastructure Engineering organization, the team that builds and operates the core foundation Arcesium's applications run on. You’ll bring a deep commitment to reliability, scalability, and performance — and Infrastructure is where that commitment carries the furthest: a change made once, at the foundation, takes effect across the entire engineering organization.

In this role you'll work across multiple functional areas within Infrastructure — including Developer Experience (AI, Observability, SDLC), Cloud Account Management, Compute, Connectivity, Customer Integration, Security, and Solutions Architecture — all built on top of AWS and Linux. You'll own one or more subsystems or services, delivering high-quality work both individually and as part of a collaborative team.

You must demonstrate high agency: combining systems thinking, a bias to action, and the willingness to challenge assumptions to assess and address the infrastructure needs, challenges, and concerns of engineering teams across Arcesium.


Responsibilities

  • Build and operate reliable, well-instrumented infrastructure services — spanning all of Infrastructure’s functional areas — that other engineers and our customer-facing applications depend on for high availability
  • Strengthen our compute platform, leveraging AWS and Kubernetes
  • Craft tools and automated solutions that streamline processes, reduce toil, and improve efficiency — applying modern tooling and, where it fits, GenAI to accelerate how infrastructure is built and operated
  • Take ownership of critical technology infrastructure built on top of multiple underlying technologies, tools, and programming languages
  • Drive process improvements and evangelize engineering best practices; help define and track the metrics that ensure we are prioritizing work that has the most impact
  • Act as a member of the broader Infrastructure organization at Arcesium, which provides the foundation upon which our customer-facing Platform runs

Qualifications

  • 3–5+ years of relevant infrastructure experience. However, we are interested more in what you've done, can do, and can grow to do, rather than the number of years you've been working.
  • A proven track record of ownership of critical infrastructure systems and delivery of features that measurably improve reliability and efficiency. You have owned and operated systems such as Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, DNS, or authentication services.
  • Polyglot programming capability, with advanced ability in at least one language. We expect engineers within Infrastructure to be proficient and prolific software engineers. Languages in our ecosystem include Python, Java, Go, and Bash.
  • Experience running critical workloads in AWS is highly valued.
  • An ability to balance delivery with correctness, delivering timely solutions that are properly risk-managed for the needs of the business.
  • A curious mind, enthusiasm for technology infrastructure, strong collaboration and communication skills, and the drive to take initiative with the right combination of independence and teamwork

Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. We encourage you to apply if you are interested in this work, even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out, especially if your background is unconventional.

The expected annual base salary for this position is $175,000 - $210,000. Our compensation package includes variable compensation in the form of a year-end bonus, guaranteed in the first year of hire, benefits including medical and prescription drug coverage, and 401k contribution matching.


The applicable annual base salary paid to a successful applicant will be determined based on multiple factors including without limitation the nature and extent of prior experience and educational background.   #LI-JS1 #LI-hybrid
