closest.text: Company Description The mission of ArisGlobal is to empower life science organizations to deliver breakthroughs faster, more accurately, and with greater precision. ArisGlobal's software, services, and technologies are essential to the delivery of life-saving medications. As an industry leader, ArisGlobal offers software as a service for Clinical Trials, Regulatory Affairs, Drug Safety, and Medical Affairs. Our products are utilized by 40 out of 50 major biopharmaceutical companies. Among our clients are four out of five of the world's most advanced global pharmaceutical companies and nine government-health authorities, including the FDA, Health Canada, and the National Medical Products Administration. ArisGlobal boasts a worldwide presence with offices located in Boston, Croatia, Slovenia, Tokyo, Shanghai, and India, At ArisGlobal, we are distinguished by the high caliber of our team and by our passion for creativity and innovation. We pride ourselves on our welcoming and supportive corporate culture, which is inclusive of all Team Members. Our challenging projects are complemented by flexible work locations and competitive salaries. Position Summary The Vice President of Product Development – Regulatory leads engineering and product development across ArisGlobal's regulatory product portfolio, including LifeSphere Regulatory (LSRG), RIMS, NavaX Regulatory Products, and Sporify. This is a senior leadership role responsible for delivery execution, product quality, and engineering culture across geographically distributed teams in Croatia and India. The role operates within a GxP-regulated life sciences environment and is a direct report to the CIO and Global Head of R&D. Responsibilities Engineering & Delivery Leadership Own end-to-end delivery across multiple product lines, from planning through release, ensuring predictable execution against program milestones and customer commitments Accountable for PI Planning cycles, sprint governance, and cross-team dependency management across distributed engineering teams Drive technical debt reduction and SaaS upgradeability as a core engineering discipline, including architecture modernization initiatives such as database migration and continuous CI/CD automation Establish and enforce engineering standards, definition of ready/done, and quality gates across all product lines. Oversee and deliver on multi-year SaaS transformation program, including multi-tenant architecture evolution, customer onboarding milestones related to program, and go-live readiness Product & Customer Accountability Partner with Product Management to maintain clear accountability boundaries between prioritization and execution, ensuring roadmap integrity and ETA credibility with customers Lead customer escalation resolution at the VP level, including cross-functional coordination with Support, Professional Services, and Customer Success Represent engineering in customer-facing forums, steering committees, and advisory boards AI & Technology Transformation Lead adoption of AI-assisted development tooling across engineering teams, including evaluation, piloting, and scaling of AI coding tools. Define and execute the organization's AI technology practice, identifying opportunities to embed AI into product development workflows and internal processes. Track and report on productivity impact and ROI of technology transformation initiatives to senior leadership. People & Organizational Leadership Build and develop high-performing engineering teams across Europe and India, including hiring, performance management, and career development Set clear goals and accountability frameworks for direct reports, including engineering managers, team leads, and senior engineers Foster a culture of engineering ownership, quality discipline, and continuous improvement Manage contractor and vendor relationships, including budget oversight and spend governance Program Governance & Reporting Maintain program governance structures for multi-year transformation programs, including milestone tracking, risk management, and executive reporting. Prepare and present board- and executive-level updates on program status, engineering health, and strategic initiatives. Manage capacity planning across teams, balancing product delivery, technical debt, and strategic investment. Your Experience Required Qualifications 10+ years of experience in software product development, with at least 5 years in a senior engineering or product leadership role. Proven track record of leading distributed engineering teams across multiple geographies. Experience delivering software in a regulated industry, preferably life sciences, pharma, or healthcare. Strong background in SaaS product delivery, including cloud-native architecture, CI/CD, and release engineering. Demonstrated ability to manage complex stakeholder environments, including direct customer engagement at an executive level. Experience running large-scale technology transformation or modernization programs. Preferred Qualifications Familiarity with regulatory submission and compliance domains (eCTD, IDMP, RIM). Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tooling and GenAI integration in product workflows. Experience with large scale transformation programs Background in both product management and engineering functions. ArisGlobal is headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts with offices located in more than 9 countries around the world. Please check out our website/LinkedIn to find out more information about the organization and other available positions. *ArisGlobal is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer and considers all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected class.

closest.title: Senior Product Manager
closest.text:
Arkose Labs is on a mission to create an online environment where all consumers are protected from spam and abuse. As a Fast Company 2025 Best Workplace for Innovators, we provide a proactive fraud deterrence platform, Arkose Titan, designed to neutralize modern attacks powered by Agentic AI and LLMs. By combining proprietary intelligence with dynamic friction, we undermine attacker ROI to protect global giants like Microsoft, Meta, and Roblox. Headquartered in San Mateo, CA, we maintain a global presence across APAC, Central and South America, and EMEA.

Role Overview

We're looking for a Product Manager to own and drive automation within our detection and mitigation systems. This role sits at the intersection of product strategy, data analysis, and machine learning operations, you'll be responsible for identifying opportunities to automate threat response, validating those opportunities through rigorous data analysis, and working closely with data scientists and engineers to bring automation solutions to production.

This is a hands-on, technically-oriented PM role. You'll spend significant time in the data yourself—validating hypotheses, understanding detection performance, and ensuring that automation investments deliver measurable impact against evolving attack patterns.

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Identify and prioritize automation opportunities based on attack trends, operational efficiency gains, and customer impact
  • Define success metrics and track performance of automation features post-launch
  • Build business cases grounded in quantitative evidence—expected detection improvements, false positive trade-offs, operational cost reductions

Data Analysis & Opportunity Validation

  • Conduct hands-on analysis of detection data, traffic patterns, and attack signatures to identify automation opportunities

About ArmorCode

ArmorCode is on a mission to supercharge security teams with a new independent governance approach to reduce risk and burn down critical security technical debt. With its AI-powered ASPM Platform, driven by over 15 billion findings from over 260 ecosystem integrations, ArmorCode delivers a single, unbiased view of your risk across applications, infrastructure, containers, and cloud. ArmorCode unifies and normalizes findings, correlates them with business context and threat intel through adaptive risk scoring, and orchestrates security workflows to empower users to easily remediate issues. ArmorCode delivers unified visibility, AI-enhanced prioritization, remediation and scalable automation for customers so they can realize a complete understanding of risk, respond at scale, and collaborate more effectively.

Enterprises of all sizes, including dozens of Fortune 1000 companies, scale their security effectiveness by more than 10x and maximize their ROI on existing security investments with ArmorCode through managing Application Security Posture, Risk-Based Vulnerability Management, Software Supply Chain Security, DevSecOps, and Risk & Compliance.‍ 

ArmorCoders believe in 5 core values: Hungry. Humble. Hardworking. Honest. Human. Our organization is powered by exceptional professionals who bring fresh ideas and passion to their roles, believing that nothing is beyond reach when our "5H" principles are applied. In their work and professional relationships, ArmorCoders commit to excellence and experiences that leave an impression.

 

What You'll Own

  • Participate in the entire application lifecycle, focusing on requirement discussions, design, coding and debugging
  • Design, build, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable Java code with Spring boot as the framework
  • Collaborating with the front-end developers and other team members to establish objectives and design
  • more functional, cohesive codes to enhance the user experience
  • Gather and address technical and design requirements
  • Provide training and support to internal teams, learn new languages as well as follow  emerging technologies
  • Taking lead on new initiatives, as needed
  • Ensure the best possible performance, quality, and responsiveness of the applications
  • Identify bottlenecks and bugs, and devise solutions to these problems
  • Help maintain code quality, organization, and automatization

 

Who you are

  • Desired experience range is 5+ years
  • Engineering degree B.E/B.Tech/MCA/M.Tech/M.Sc or any Equivalent Degree
  • Proven work experience as a Back-end developer
  • In-depth understanding of the entire web development process (design, development and deployment)
  • Proficient in Java, with a good knowledge of its ecosystems
  • Basic understanding of JVM, its limitations, weaknesses, and workarounds
  • Ability to decide when to use relational vs NoSQL databases and must be experienced with at least one of the relational databases
  • Familiarity with concepts of MVC, JDBC, and RESTful
  • Experience with Spring, Spring Boot, Spring MVC
  • Experience in CI/CD and Cloud technologies
  • Expertise in developing enterprise-level web applications and RESTful APIs using MicroServices, with demonstrable production-scale experience
  • Familiarity with front-end languages (e.g., HTML, JavaScript and CSS)
  • Excellent analytical and time management skills
  • Teamwork skills with a problem-solving attitude

 

Why you will love it : 

  • Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in promoting from within and provide career progression paths, enabling our employees to advance in their careers
  • Work-Life Balance: We understand the importance of a healthy work-life balance, offering flexible hours and remote work options to promote a sustainable lifestyle
  • Collaborative Environment: Our company fosters a collaborative and inclusive workplace culture, where employees can collaborate and learn from each other's experiences
  • Employee Recognition: We value and recognize the contributions of our team members through awards, employee of the month programs, and other forms of acknowledgment.
  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salaries and performance-based bonuses, recognizing and rewarding the hard work and dedication of our team
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Our benefits package includes health insurance for employees and dependents, to support the overall well-being of our employees. We encourage learning and skilling, and aid our employees to continuously upskill themselves.
  • Diversity and Inclusion: We are committed to diversity and inclusion, striving to create an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and empowered

Join ArmorCode and lead the charge in reducing signal fatigue, prioritizing risk and streamlining key cybersecurity workflows. Apply today to be part of a close-knit team, dedicated to democratizing software security and helping build the safest software possible.

Equal Opportunity

ArmorCode is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or any other legally protected category. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply and will receive consideration for employment regardless of their background or characteristics. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone is treated with respect and dignity.

closest.text: Position: Product Engineer Job Description: Since 1982, NIC Components (NIC), in partnership with Nippon Industries Co. Ltd., has been a global solutions provider in passive components to fuel the designs of technology and engineering organizations. As a leader in passive component technology, NIC’s offerings of passive components — including a wide range of capacitors, circuit protection products, inductors, magnetics, resistors, and RF products — are built to meet the challenges of modern electronics design. We are looking for a Product Engineer to serve as a key technical resource across NIC Components’ full portfolio of passive electronic components (including capacitors, inductors, resistors, magnetics, and RF products). This role will be responsible for supporting both internal teams and customers with component selection , competitive cross-referencing, and technical data validation. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of passive components and the ability to translate application requirements or competitor part numbers into optimized NIC solutions. It also offers the opportunity to work with colleagues and suppliers worldwide. This is a hybrid role based in our Long Island, NY office, with a combination of office and home working. What You'll Be Doing: Develop strong working knowledge of NIC’s passive component portfolio to support technical and product-related inquiries Utilize internal databases and parametric tools to recommend component selections based on: Application requirements Functional descriptions Competitor part numbers Ability to successfully offer component selection or generate cross-reference options, including identifying pin-for-pin and functionally equivalent replacements Validate and improve the accuracy of existing parametric and product data Contribute to NIC's technical marketing catalog including white papers, test reports, and marketing material . Resolve customer issues related to component selection Query datasets and generate reports to support advanced applications, customers, and internal decision-making Participate in customer discussions as the technical voice for parametric and product data. Assist in developing and enhancing internal tools that leverage component parametric attributes Collaborate closely with engineering, product management, and sales teams to ensure technical alignment and responsiveness What We're Looking For: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering , Computer Engineering, or related field 2–5 years of experience in component engineering, product engineering, or a related technical role Strong understanding of passive electronic components and circuit-level design considerations Experience working with parametric data, technical databases, or component selection tools Ability to interpret datasheets and translate technical specifications into practical recommendations Strong analytical skills and attention to detail Effective communication skills with ability to interact with both technical and commercial stakeholders. Experience with component cross-referencing and competitive analysis Advanced proficiency in Excel or other data analysis tools Familiarity with database querying or data management systems Exposure to customer-facing technical support or field application engineering Work Arrangement: Hybrid: 3 days in office/2 days work from home What's In It For You: Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance 401k, With Matching Contributions Short-Term/Long-Term Disability Insurance Health Savings Account (HSA)/Health Reimbursement Account (HRA) Options Paid Time Off (including sick , holiday, vacation, etc.) Tuition Reimbursement Growth Opportunities And more! Annual Hiring Range/Hourly Rate: $75,240.00 - $91,960.00 Actual compensation offer to candidate may vary from posted hiring range based upon geographic location, work experience, education, and/or skill level. The pay ratio between base pay and target incentive (if applicable) will be finalized at offer. closest.title: Software Quality Engineer
closest.text: The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community. The Role AspenTech is looking for individuals to join our growing Product Quality Team in the role of Software Quality Engineer testing Aspen Products providing next generation Engineering, Manufacturing, and Asset Optimization solutions. This is your opportunity to play an important role in this cutting-edge transformation. We are looking for a Software Quality Engineer to create and execute testing approaches for our market-leading Operational Technology (OT) products, with a key objective of designing and developing low maintenance and portable test automation scripts using some of the latest industry technologies. You will create robust test strategies to search out product issues while assuring that the product line conforms to established requirements and standards. You will also be responsible for gathering functional requirements, information, and data to proactively drive quality best practices while collaborating with R&D and Product Management. Your Impact Design, build, execute, and maintain test automation including backend, UI, and API. Create automated test scripts for non-functional system verification. Work within CI/CD pipelines to build, configure, and patch multiple test environments. Perform requirements analysis, create, and execute test strategies and test cases, troubleshoot issues, and report defects. Manually execute complex functional and non-functional tests. Engage with cross-functional and international teams on status updates and problem solving in an agile environment. What You'll Need Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related technical field. 0-3 years’ work experience. High level scripting skills (Python, Perl, Shell scripting). Proficient with Linux and Windows environments. System Administration experience (small system or personal networks is great). Understanding of manual and/or automated testing best practices. Innate desires to automate, monitor and continually improve everything in sight. Experience with different database technologies (SQL, Cassandra, MongoDB). Understanding of Configuration Management. Knowledge of automation tool building and test automation frameworks. Capability to maintain Windows/Linux/UNIX Servers. Experience in server virtualization, especially VMWare and VSphere. General networking skills (Layer 2 & 3 switches, TCP/IP, SNMP, etc.). Experience with a source control system (CVS, Subversion, Git, etc.).

 About Us: 
 Atlas Systems Inc. is a Software Solutions company headquartered in East Brunswick, NJ. Incorporated in 2003, Atlas provides comprehensive range of solutions in the area of GRC, Technology, Procurement, Healthcare Provider and Oracle to customers across the globe. Combining our unparalleled experience of over a decade in the software industry and global reach, we have grown with extensive capabilities across industry verticals. 
 For more information, please visit our website  https://www.atlassystems.com / 
 
 Please click on the link below to apply for this position: 
 https://atlas.bamboohr.com/careers/591 
 
   
 Job Title: Forward Deployment Engineer (AI Solutions) 
 Location: Bangalore (Work from Office / Hybrid as applicable) 
 Work Timing: IST Hours 
 Experience: 3+ Years 
 Engagement Type: Long-term / Multi-year (Contract / Full-time) 
 
 Position Summary 
 We are looking for a passionate Forward Deployment Engineer to build and deploy AI-powered software solutions that solve real business problems. This role combines customer engagement, full-stack software engineering, and AI application development to rapidly deliver production-ready solutions. 
 As a Forward Deployment Engineer, you will work closely with Solution Architects, customers, and cross-functional engineering teams to understand business requirements, develop AI-enabled applications, build rapid Proof of Concepts (PoCs), integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) into enterprise systems, and accelerate customer adoption using an AI-first development approach. You will also work on optimizing , securing & deploying the final solution for customer consumption. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 AI Solution Development 
 
 Design, develop, and deploy AI-powered full-stack applications using modern software engineering practices. 
 Build intelligent applications by integrating Generative AI, LLMs, AI Agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), semantic search, and workflow automation. 
 Develop reusable APIs, services, and components that enable rapid AI solution delivery. 
 Optimize AI application performance, scalability, security, and reliability. 
 
 Customer Engagement & Rapid Prototyping 
 
 Work closely with Solution Architects and customers to understand business challenges and translate them into working software. 
 Rapidly build Proof of Concepts (PoCs), prototypes, and Minimum Viable Products (MVPs) to validate AI use cases and demonstrate business value. 
 Present solution capabilities to customers, gather feedback, iterate quickly, and help build customer confidence and commitment for production implementation. 
 Configure, customize, and integrate AI solutions with enterprise applications and business workflows. 
 Support customer deployments, testing, and production rollouts. 
 
 AI-First Software Engineering 
 
 Leverage AI-assisted development tools and coding copilots to accelerate software delivery. 
 Apply AI-first engineering practices across the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), including solution design, coding, testing, debugging, documentation, and automation. 
 Develop scalable cloud-native applications using modern architectures, APIs, microservices, and event-driven design. 
 Write clean, secure, maintainable, and well-tested code following engineering best practices. 
 
 Collaboration & Innovation 
 
 Collaborate with product, architecture, cloud, DevOps, and QA teams to deliver high-quality AI solutions. 
 Continuously evaluate and adopt emerging AI technologies, frameworks, tools, and engineering practices to improve solution quality and delivery speed. 
 Contribute reusable components, accelerators, technical documentation, and best practices to enhance organizational capabilities. 
 
 
 Required Qualifications 
 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. 
 3–5 years of experience in full-stack software development. 
 Hands-on experience building cloud-native web applications and APIs. 
 Experience developing or integrating AI-powered applications using Large Language Models (LLMs) or Generative AI platforms. 
 Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to work directly with customers and cross-functional teams. 
 
 
 Technical Skills 
 Programming 
 
 Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, C#, or Node.js 
 React, Angular, or Vue.js 
 REST APIs, GraphQL, and Microservices 
 
 Artificial Intelligence 
 
 Generative AI 
 Large Language Models (LLMs) 
 Prompt Engineering 
 Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) 
 AI Agents 
 LangChain, LangGraph, or similar orchestration frameworks 
 OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Google Vertex AI 
 
 Cloud & DevOps 
 
 Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform 
 Docker, Kubernetes (preferred) 
 Git and CI/CD pipelines 
 
 Databases 
 
 SQL, NoSQL, and Vector Databases 
 
 Core Competencies 
 
 AI-First Software Development 
 Full-Stack Engineering 
 Rapid PoC & MVP Development 
 Customer-Centric Problem Solving 
 API & Enterprise System Integration 
 Cloud-Native Application Development 
 Collaboration & Ownership 
 Strong Communication & Presentation Skills 
 Quick Learner with a strong passion for experimenting with and adopting emerging technologies 
 Growth mindset with the agility to rapidly learn new AI models, frameworks, tools, and engineering practices in a fast-evolving technology landscape 
 
 Success Measures 
 
 Deliver high-quality AI-powered applications that solve customer business problems. 
 Rapidly develop impactful PoCs and MVPs that demonstrate value and help secure customer commitment. 
 Accelerate software delivery through AI-first engineering practices and modern development tools. 
 Build reusable components that improve engineering productivity and solution quality. 
 Continuously upskill and adopt emerging technologies to drive innovation and delivery excellence. 
 Contribute to high customer satisfaction through quality implementation, responsiveness, and technical excellence.

 Job Summary 
   
 Company provides comprehensive hosted services for retail brokerage customers’ end-to-end business operations.  The core of these services runs on multiple IBM Parallel Sysplex environments utilizing IBM’s DB2 z/OS in a high-performance, highly-available data-sharing configuration.  This DB2 Systems Administrator Team Lead role is responsible for the installation, maintenance, and administration of the DB2 z/OS subsystem and associated support products to support the demands of the fast-paced, time-critical financial trading industry. 
   
   
 Essential Responsibilities 
   
 
 Installation/maintenance of IBM DB2 z/OS software and related 3rd-party products utilizing SMP/E. This includes working with IBM and other vendors to address product defects, issues, and usage questions. 
 Configuration of DB2 groups and subsystems in SYSPLEX data-sharing environment, supporting IBM CICS, batch COBOL, and distributed access applications. 
 Perform problem analysis and resolution, both technical and application related 
 Performance and capacity tuning of system parameters and resources, utilizing various monitoring and reporting tools. 
 Responsible for DB2 availability and recovery strategies and procedures. 
 Documentation of policies and procedures in compliance with ISO 27002 standards. 
 Provide mentoring and cross-functional collaboration with business units. 
 Provide secondary and level 2 support for the DBA staff on system issues, application. performance and overall DB2 issues, including being comfortable with high-pressure, time-sensitive environments. 
 
   
   
 Qualifications 
 
 
 12+ years IBM System Z experience and concepts, with considerable knowledge in the following: 
 
 SMP/E 
 IBM DB2 utilities, BMC Mainview for DB2 and BMC Tool Suite for DB2, particularly Detector, Subsystem analyzer, Apptune, AMI Reorg and AMI Unload/Load 
 Experience with DB2 z/OS as a distributed server 
 FLASH technology, DASD replication techniques 
 z/OS Storage management 
 RACF security management w/DB2 z/OS 
 Coupling Facility 
 Networking concepts (IP, SNA) 
 WLM concepts 
 USS - z/OS UNIX System Services 
 ‘For-Bit’ Data structures 
 REXX application programming 
 
 
 
   
   
 
 7+ years IBM DB2 experience, with advanced knowledge in the following: 
 
 Bufferpool/memory management 
 DB2 internal structures (RID, EDM, BPs, etc.) 
 Tablespace/Page structures / UTS 
 Backup/recovery/logging facilities and strategies 
 DB2 locking 
 ZPARMS 
 DB2 tracing/IFCIDs 
 
 
 Experience in problem determination and analysis 
 Analytical / critical / “outside-the-box” thinking in problem solving, especially in possible critical, high-pressure situations. 
 
   
 Additional Skills A Plus 
 
 Informatica PowerExchange & IDMC 
 Java, web services, SOA concepts 
 Application DBA Responsibilities 
 DB2-AI and Cloud Modernization Technology

 About Us: 
 Atlas Systems Inc. is a Software Solutions company headquartered in East Brunswick, NJ. Incorporated in 2003, Atlas provides comprehensive range of solutions in the area of GRC, Technology, Procurement, Healthcare Provider and Oracle to customers across the globe. Combining our unparalleled experience of over a decade in the software industry and global reach, we have grown with extensive capabilities across industry verticals. 
 For more information, please visit our website  https://www.atlassystems.com / 
 
 Please click on the link below to apply for this position: 
 https://atlas.bamboohr.com/careers/591 
 
   
 Job Title: Forward Deployment Engineer (AI Solutions) 
 Location: Bangalore (Work from Office / Hybrid as applicable) 
 Work Timing: IST Hours 
 Experience: 3+ Years 
 Engagement Type: Long-term / Multi-year (Contract / Full-time) 
 
 Position Summary 
 We are looking for a passionate Forward Deployment Engineer to build and deploy AI-powered software solutions that solve real business problems. This role combines customer engagement, full-stack software engineering, and AI application development to rapidly deliver production-ready solutions. 
 As a Forward Deployment Engineer, you will work closely with Solution Architects, customers, and cross-functional engineering teams to understand business requirements, develop AI-enabled applications, build rapid Proof of Concepts (PoCs), integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) into enterprise systems, and accelerate customer adoption using an AI-first development approach. You will also work on optimizing , securing & deploying the final solution for customer consumption. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 AI Solution Development 
 
 Design, develop, and deploy AI-powered full-stack applications using modern software engineering practices. 
 Build intelligent applications by integrating Generative AI, LLMs, AI Agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), semantic search, and workflow automation. 
 Develop reusable APIs, services, and components that enable rapid AI solution delivery. 
 Optimize AI application performance, scalability, security, and reliability. 
 
 Customer Engagement & Rapid Prototyping 
 
 Work closely with Solution Architects and customers to understand business challenges and translate them into working software. 
 Rapidly build Proof of Concepts (PoCs), prototypes, and Minimum Viable Products (MVPs) to validate AI use cases and demonstrate business value. 
 Present solution capabilities to customers, gather feedback, iterate quickly, and help build customer confidence and commitment for production implementation. 
 Configure, customize, and integrate AI solutions with enterprise applications and business workflows. 
 Support customer deployments, testing, and production rollouts. 
 
 AI-First Software Engineering 
 
 Leverage AI-assisted development tools and coding copilots to accelerate software delivery. 
 Apply AI-first engineering practices across the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), including solution design, coding, testing, debugging, documentation, and automation. 
 Develop scalable cloud-native applications using modern architectures, APIs, microservices, and event-driven design. 
 Write clean, secure, maintainable, and well-tested code following engineering best practices. 
 
 Collaboration & Innovation 
 
 Collaborate with product, architecture, cloud, DevOps, and QA teams to deliver high-quality AI solutions. 
 Continuously evaluate and adopt emerging AI technologies, frameworks, tools, and engineering practices to improve solution quality and delivery speed. 
 Contribute reusable components, accelerators, technical documentation, and best practices to enhance organizational capabilities. 
 
 
 Required Qualifications 
 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. 
 3–5 years of experience in full-stack software development. 
 Hands-on experience building cloud-native web applications and APIs. 
 Experience developing or integrating AI-powered applications using Large Language Models (LLMs) or Generative AI platforms. 
 Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to work directly with customers and cross-functional teams. 
 
 
 Technical Skills 
 Programming 
 
 Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, C#, or Node.js 
 React, Angular, or Vue.js 
 REST APIs, GraphQL, and Microservices 
 
 Artificial Intelligence 
 
 Generative AI 
 Large Language Models (LLMs) 
 Prompt Engineering 
 Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) 
 AI Agents 
 LangChain, LangGraph, or similar orchestration frameworks 
 OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Google Vertex AI 
 
 Cloud & DevOps 
 
 Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform 
 Docker, Kubernetes (preferred) 
 Git and CI/CD pipelines 
 
 Databases 
 
 SQL, NoSQL, and Vector Databases 
 
 Core Competencies 
 
 AI-First Software Development 
 Full-Stack Engineering 
 Rapid PoC & MVP Development 
 Customer-Centric Problem Solving 
 API & Enterprise System Integration 
 Cloud-Native Application Development 
 Collaboration & Ownership 
 Strong Communication & Presentation Skills 
 Quick Learner with a strong passion for experimenting with and adopting emerging technologies 
 Growth mindset with the agility to rapidly learn new AI models, frameworks, tools, and engineering practices in a fast-evolving technology landscape 
 
 Success Measures 
 
 Deliver high-quality AI-powered applications that solve customer business problems. 
 Rapidly develop impactful PoCs and MVPs that demonstrate value and help secure customer commitment. 
 Accelerate software delivery through AI-first engineering practices and modern development tools. 
 Build reusable components that improve engineering productivity and solution quality. 
 Continuously upskill and adopt emerging technologies to drive innovation and delivery excellence. 
 Contribute to high customer satisfaction through quality implementation, responsiveness, and technical excellence.

closest.title: AI Deployment Engineer
closest.text: THE ROLE: AI Deployment Engineer Location: United States | Work Mode: Remote / Field-Present | Employment Type: Full Time About Forward Deployed Engineering Aurigo's central platform team builds the AI agents. Forward Deployed Engineering works alongside agencies to deploy them into production, ensure they perform reliably, and evolve them as customer needs change. The team bridges product innovation and real world operations, turning AI capabilities into measurable outcomes for public infrastructure agencies. As an AI Deployment Engineer, you are the technical core of that mission. Role Overview Aurigo is looking for an AI Deployment Engineer to join its Forward Deployed Engineering team. This is a hands on deployment and integration role, not a model development role. You will lead the technical deployment of AI agents into customer environments, integrating them with enterprise systems, validating their performance, and ensuring they deliver reliable outcomes in production. You will work directly with agency tech teams, business stakeholders, and Aurigo's Product and Engineering teams to solve technical challenges, optimize deployments, and continuously improve how AI is adopted across customer workflows. Every deployment helps shape the playbooks, tooling, and best practices that make future deployments faster, more scalable, and more successful. Travel is a core part of this role as you will regularly work alongside customers during deployment, adoption, and expansion. WHAT YOU'LL DO: Agent Deployment & Integration Configure and deploy Aurigo AI agents within customer Masterworks environments — tailoring agent behavior, workflows, and outputs to each agency's specific requirements Build and maintain data integrations between Masterworks and agency systems: scheduling tools, cost systems, financial management platforms, document management, GIS, and agency data warehouses Develop scripts and lightweight automation to streamline agency data workflows, reduce manual handoffs, and prepare data for agent consumption Work with agency IT staff, data stewards, and system administrators to navigate access, permissions, and integration constraints in government technology environments Troubleshoot deployment issues in the field — diagnosing root causes, implementing fixes, and documenting solutions for reuse across future deployments Configuration, Monitoring & Outcomes Configure deployed agents in Aurigo's agent builder — setting workflow logic, prompts, output formats, and thresholds so each agent matches how the agency actually works, in close collaboration with the Agent Designer and domain SME Connect agents to agency data — build and maintain the integrations and data-preparation steps that feed clean, structured inputs from Masterworks and connected systems into each agent Monitor agents in production — track output quality against the outcomes each agent is contracted to deliver, catch degradation or drift early, and adjust configuration to keep performance on target Diagnose and resolve deployment and performance issues in the field — identify root causes, implement configuration or integration fixes, and document them for reuse across future deployments Feed field learnings back to the central AI platform team — when an agent needs a capability that configuration alone cannot provide, you are the channel that turns that into a product request, so the fix ships once and improves every account Requirements: Candidate Profile Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, AI, or related field from a premier institution. Master's degree preferred. 3+ years in a hands-on technical delivery role — solutions or deployment engineering, systems integration, or implementation engineering — putting software into real production environments where reliability matters Strong integration and scripting skills: connecting enterprise systems through REST APIs, moving and reshaping data between platforms, and automating data-preparation workflows (Python or comparable) Hands-on comfort configuring and operating modern AI agent or LLM-based tools — prompt and workflow configuration, agent setup, and judging whether outputs are reliable; you do not need to have trained models, you need to be excellent at making already-built agents perform Experience working with unstructured and semi-structured data — PDFs, XML exports, structured logs — and preparing it so downstream systems and agents can consume it Ability to work independently in ambiguous field environments — you diagnose and build without waiting for a perfectly scoped ticket Preferred Experience Experience monitoring software or model performance in production — spotting drift or degradation and acting on it before it affects the customer Experience with construction, infrastructure, or capital program data — cost codes, schedule structures, contract document formats, or similar domain data Prior work in a field deployment, systems integration, or technical consulting role — you have built in client environments under real constraints Familiarity with agent platforms or retrieval/vector search from a configuration-and-integration standpoint (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, or equivalent) Experience in government or regulated environments — navigating IT procurement, access controls, and security requirements Public Trust clearance eligibility About Aurigo Aurigo is an AI-native capital program management platform trusted by over 300 customers managing more than $300 billion in capital programs across North America. With over 40,000 projects delivered, Aurigo helps organisations in transportation, water and utilities, healthcare, higher education, and government plan, build, and manage infrastructure with confidence. Recognised as one of the Top 25 AI Companies of 2024 and a Great Place to Work for three consecutive years, we leverage artificial intelligence to create smarter, more connected outcomes. At Aurigo, we don't just build software — we help shape the future of infrastructure.

matches.text: Job Requisition ID # 26WD100406 English will follow Voici une occasion exceptionnelle de travailler aux côtés de professionnels qui développent des outils infonuagiques de gestion de production et de collaboration pour l'industrie des médias et du divertissement. Flow Capture permet aux équipes créatives de gérer, de réviser et de collaborer sur leurs contenus tout au long du cycle de production, en soutenant les artistes, les coordinateurs, les superviseurs et les studios dans la réalisation de projets ambitieux. Vous aurez l'occasion d'acquérir une expérience concrète en développement logiciel au sein d'un environnement stimulant, créatif et collaboratif. Vous travaillerez avec une équipe d'ingénieurs, de concepteurs et de spécialistes produit expérimentés qui vous accompagneront dans le développement de vos compétences en technologies Web, infonuagiques et en workflows de production audiovisuelle. Veuillez noter qu'il s'agit d'un poste hybride pour la session d'hiver 2027 (de janvier à avril 2027). Responsabilités Participer activement à l'équipe d'ingénierie de Flow Capture en développant des fonctionnalités qui améliorent la collaboration, la révision, la gestion des ressources et les workflows de production. Contribuer au développement d'applications et de services Web modernes utilisés par les professionnels du cinéma, de la télévision, de l'animation, du jeu vidéo et d'autres secteurs de la production multimédia. Prendre part aux sprints de conception, de développement et de tests afin de livrer des solutions logicielles de qualité. Collaborer avec les ingénieurs, les chefs de produit, les concepteurs UX, les spécialistes de l'assurance qualité et les autres parties prenantes pour transformer les besoins des clients en fonctionnalités. Écrire un code clair, maintenable et testé en appliquant les bonnes pratiques du développement logiciel. Qualifications minimales Être inscrit(e) en informatique, en génie logiciel, en génie informatique ou dans un domaine connexe, idéalement en deuxième année ou plus. Posséder une expérience en développement logiciel backend ou orienté objet, de préférence avec Java ou un langage similaire (Kotlin, C#, Python ou Go). Maîtriser les concepts fondamentaux du développement logiciel : structures de données, algorithmes, programmation orientée objet et conception logicielle. Avoir une expérience avec les API (REST, GraphQL ou équivalent). Connaître les bases de données relationnelles, SQL et les principes de modélisation des données. Démontrer un intérêt pour le développement infonuagique et les plateformes telles qu'Amazon Web Services (AWS). Avoir de bonnes aptitudes en collaboration, en communication technique et en travail d'équipe. Faire preuve de curiosité, d'initiative et d'une volonté d'apprendre et de progresser. Qualifications souhaitées Expérience en développement backend Java et avec les frameworks courants pour les services Web. Connaissance des tests automatisés (unitaires, fonctionnels, d'intégration ou de composants). Familiarité avec les pratiques DevOps (CI/CD, Git, pipelines de build, déploiement, observabilité et infrastructure infonuagique). Expérience en développement front-end ou full-stack (Angular, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS), un atout. Intérêt pour l'IA/ML, l'automatisation et les services backend intelligents. Intérêt pour les médias et le divertissement, la production audiovisuelle, les outils de collaboration créative ou les applications SaaS à grande échelle. À propos du programme de stages au Canada Le programme 2027 au Canada dure 16 semaines (du 4 janvier au 23 avril). Tous les stages sont rémunérés. En tant que stagiaire, vous contribuerez à des projets significatifs, serez encadré par des leaders du secteur, participerez à des conférences techniques et à d'autres activités conçues pour soutenir votre développement personnel et professionnel. Nos stages s'inscrivent dans le cadre de l'approche « Flexible Workplace » d'Autodesk, qui vise à répondre aux besoins de notre entreprise tout en offrant une flexibilité pour soutenir les préférences de travail au bureau, à distance et en mode hybride. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Here is an incredible opportunity to work with professionals building cloud-based production management and collaboration tools for the media and entertainment industry. Flow Capture helps creative teams manage, review, and collaborate on content throughout the production lifecycle, supporting artists, coordinators, supervisors, and studios as they bring ambitious projects to life. This is a great opportunity to gain front-line software development experience in a stimulating, creative, and highly collaborative environment. You will work with a team of experienced engineers, designers, and product professionals who will provide guidance, share their expertise, and help you grow your skills in modern web, cloud, and media production workflows. Please note that this is a hybrid position for Winter 2027 (January - April 2027 work term). Responsibilities Be an active member of the Flow Capture engineering team, helping develop features that improve collaboration, review, asset management, and production workflows for our customers. Contribute to modern web-based applications and services used by creative professionals in film, television, animation, games, and other media production environments. Participate in iterative design, testing, and development sprints to refine product solutions and deliver high-quality software. Collaborate with software engineers, product managers, UX designers, QA specialists, and other stakeholders to understand customer needs and turn ideas into working features. Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code while learning professional software development practices. Minimum Qualifications Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, preferably in your second year or later. Experience with backend or object-oriented software development, preferably using Java or a similar language such as Kotlin, C#, Python, or Go. Understanding of software development fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, object-oriented programming, and basic software design principles. Some experience designing, building, or consuming APIs, such as REST services, GraphQL, or similar service interfaces. Some experience working with databases, including relational databases, SQL, data modeling, or database-backed application development. Interest in cloud-based software development and deployment technologies such as Amazon Web Services. Comfort working collaboratively with others, communicating technical ideas clearly, and sharing your work with a team. Curiosity, initiative, and a willingness to ask questions, receive feedback, and grow as a software engineer. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Java backend development, including frameworks or tools commonly used for web services. Exposure to automated testing frameworks and practices for unit, component, functional, or integration testing. Familiarity with DevOps concepts such as CI/CD, source control, build pipelines, deployment, observability, or cloud infrastructure. Exposure to frontend or full-stack development is a plus, especially with Angular, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, or CSS. Interest in AI/ML frameworks, intelligent backend services, automation, or applying AI-assisted capabilities to improve workflows and system performance. Interest in media and entertainment, film production, production tracking, creative collaboration tools, or high-profile SaaS applications. About the Canada Intern Program The 2027 Canada program runs for 16 weeks (January 4th – April 23rd). All internships are paid. As an intern, you will contribute to meaningful projects, be mentored by industry leaders, participate in tech talks and other activities designed to support your personal and professional development. Our Internships align with Autodesk’s Flexible Workplace approach, which is designed to meet the needs of our business while providing flexibility in support of office, remote and hybrid work preferences. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made. We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. matches.title: Software Engineer II
matches.text: About Avaya Avaya is an enterprise software leader that helps the world’s largest organizations and government agencies forge unbreakable connections. The Avaya Infinity™ platform unifies fragmented customer experiences, connecting the channels, insights, technologies, and workflows that together create enduring customer and employee relationships. We believe success is built through strong connections – with each other, with our work, and with our mission. At Avaya, you'll find a community that values your contributions and supports your growth every step of the way. Learn more at https://www.avaya.com Job Information Job Code: 00194009 Job Family: Research and Development Job Function: Software Engineering About The Opportunity We are seeking highly skilled QA Automation Engineers (DevOps) to drive quality engineering for Unified Communications (UC) and Contact Center platforms. This role focuses on validating delivery and runtime behavior for DevOps-led changes across CI/CD, deployments, shared environments, platform integrations, and service reliability. Engineers will own automation strategy, release quality evidence, deployment validation, and runtime assurance in partnership with Platform, DevOps, Cloud, and Product Engineering teams. The ideal candidate brings strong automation engineering expertise, critical system-thinking, and hands-on experience validating cloud-native deployments, APIs, platform integrations, and operational readiness in large-scale enterprise communication ecosystems. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain automated validation frameworks for DevOps delivery flows, including build validation, artifact verification, deployment validation, smoke/health testing, rollback testing, and release readiness. Validate Kubernetes-backed deployments for Unified Communications and Contact Center workloads, including rollout status, readiness/liveness behavior, ingress, service exposure, pod health, and runtime observability. Integrate automated validation suites into CI/CD pipelines such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and Azure DevOps to enable continuous quality gates. Validate end-to-end service integrations across communication workflows, APIs, platform services, identity systems, and dependent microservices. Analyze and triage failures across pipeline logs, deployment metadata, Kubernetes events, and runtime logs to identify defects affecting delivery stability and cross-team integration. Own automation coverage strategy, quality gates, test cataloging, and exit criteria for DevOps-led platform changes. Reduce test instability by identifying flaky automation patterns and improving reliability, diagnostics, and repeatability. Validate REST APIs, JSON/YAML payloads, service contracts, and integration points for UC and Contact Center capabilities. Document environment dependencies, limitations, validation evidence, release readiness metrics, and defect impact assessments. Collaborate with Platform Engineering, DevOps, SRE, Cloud, and Product teams to improve delivery quality, deployment confidence, and operational resilience. About The Requirements Required Qualifications 6–8 years of experience in QA Automation, SDET, Software Test Engineering, or Platform Validation roles. Strong programming expertise in Python, TypeScript, Java, or C# with solid Git/Git workflow experience. Hands-on experience integrating automation into CI/CD systems such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps. Strong Kubernetes validation experience, including kubectl usage, rollout verification, pod inspection, log analysis, service troubleshooting, readiness/liveness validation, and deployment debugging. Hands-on experience validating containers, REST APIs, JSON/YAML payloads, and distributed platform integrations. Cloud validation experience with Azure and GCP, including environment validation and deployment verification. Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to analyze failures across logs, deployment metadata, and integration paths. Experience defining automation coverage, release exit criteria, and quality evidence for production readiness. Preferred Skills Exposure to managed Kubernetes platforms such as AKS and GKE. Experience validating GitOps workflows (Argo CD) and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/Ansible) from a QA or validation perspective. Knowledge of OAuth2/OIDC authentication and Keycloak integration testing. Scripting proficiency in PowerShell and/or Bash for validation, diagnostics, and automation. Experience testing Unified Communications, Contact Center, VoIP, SIP, media services, routing, call flows, integrations, or enterprise communication systems. Understanding of distributed systems, observability, deployment resiliency, and production-quality validation. Key Competencies Strong critical thinking and system-level troubleshooting skills Automation-first quality mindset High ownership and accountability for release quality Cross-functional collaboration across DevOps, Platform, Cloud, and Engineering teams Strong analytical and debugging capabilities in complex distributed systems Why Join Us This role offers an opportunity to work on enterprise-grade Unified Communications and Contact Center platforms, driving quality across cloud-native deployments, DevOps automation, CI/CD, and large-scale service integrations while shaping delivery excellence and platform reliability. Experience 2 - 3 Years experience or Engineer One equivalent Education Bachelor degree or equivalent experience Master degree or equivalent experience Preferred Certifications Footer Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future. Avaya is an Equal Opportunity employer and a U.S. Federal Contractor. Our commitment to equality is a core value of Avaya. All qualified applicants and employees receive equal treatment without consideration for race, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other protected characteristic. In general, positions at Avaya require the ability to communicate and use office technology effectively. Physical requirements may vary by assigned work location. This job brief/description is subject to change. Nothing in this job description restricts Avaya right to alter the duties and responsibilities of this position at any time for any reason.

nearMatches.title: Search Engineer (Solr, Alibaba OpenSearch - Elasticsearch Service)
nearMatches.text: AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software. Our cutting-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals and minerals – safely, efficiently and more sustainably. We’re the first software business in the world to have our sustainability targets validated by the SBTi, and we’ve been recognized for the transparency and ambition of our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We’ve also recently been named as one of the world’s most innovative companies. If you’re a curious and collaborative person who wants to make a big impact through technology, then we want to hear from you! Find out more at AVEVA Careers . For more information about our privacy policy and how to manage cookies, visit our Privacy Policy . Job Title: Search Engineer Location: Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia Employment Type: Regular, full-time, hybrid work arrangement The job We are looking for a Search Engineer to join AVEVA’s newly established AI & Digital Delivery hub in Kuala Lumpur. In this role, you will shape and deliver fast, relevant, and AI-enhanced search experiences across customer and partner portals. You will work with technologies such as Solr, Elasticsearch, and Alibaba OpenSearch to support discovery across product catalogues, documentation, partner resources, and knowledge bases, helping users find the right information quickly and confidently. Key responsibilities Design and implement search architecture for the Unified Partner Experience and customer portal platforms. Deploy, configure, and optimise Solr, Elasticsearch, and/or Alibaba OpenSearch for multi-region search workloads. Develop search relevancy models, including scoring, boosting, synonyms, and query analysis. Build search APIs, indexing pipelines, faceted search, auto-complete, type-ahead, and AI-enhanced search features. Monitor search performance, relevancy metrics, and user behaviour to continuously improve search quality. Essential requirements Strong hands-on experience with Apache Solr and/or Elasticsearch , including cluster management, schema design, and query tuning. Experience designing search relevancy models, scoring approaches, indexing pipelines, and ETL processes. Proficiency in at least one backend language such as C# , Python , or Java . Understanding of NLP fundamentals for search, including tokenisation, stemming, and entity recognition. 5–8 years of experience in search engineering or information retrieval, including production-scale search delivery. Desired skills Familiarity with cloud-managed search services such as Azure Cognitive Search, AWS OpenSearch, or Alibaba OpenSearch. Experience with vector search, semantic search, embeddings, RAG patterns, CJK tokenisation, Kafka, or Learning to Rank models. Curiosity and aspiration to keep learning emerging search, AI, and information retrieval technologies. Strong analytical, data-driven, and user-focused mindset, with the ability to build trust through measurable search improvements. Additional proficiency in Mandarin is an advantage, as the role may involve supporting stakeholders and business activities in Mandarin-speaking markets. IT at AVEVA Our global team of 300+ IT professionals is responsible for the systems and platforms that keep AVEVA running. By empowering our colleagues and ensuring the smooth operation of the company, we help keep the business healthy and productivity high. We also provide key support for the transformation and modernisation efforts globally. We pride ourselves on a collaborative, inclusive and authentic culture that provides a framework allowing for autonomy, whilst always being available for support and guidance. We respect the differences that each team member brings and seek to include those perspectives in our solutions for our business functions. The energy and sense of purpose is evident when talking to team members, you will feel part of something special from the first day you join. Find out more: https://www.aveva.com/en/about/careers/ AVEVA requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third party personal data may involve additional background check criteria. AVEVA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business. Come and join AVEVA to create the transformative technology that enables our customers to engineer a better world.

closest.text: AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies. Job Title: R&D Member of Technical Staff Location: Hyderabad, India Employment Type: Regular, full time, hybrid work arrangement The Job At this time, we are seeking to hire a self-driven, results oriented and seasoned Software Development professional with 1 – 3 years of hands-on Software Development experience that includes the following. A suitable candidate would love to develop software in a fast-paced team environment, thoroughly enjoys coding and has a strong continuous improvement mindset. Key Responsibilities Develop and test Microsoft Windows-based software systems using C#, .NET, and SQL in a collaborative, fast-paced team environment Apply Test Driven Development (TDD) and Continuous Integration practices to ensure high-quality, reliable software delivery Contribute to Agile development ceremonies and sprint cycles, maintaining a strong continuous improvement mindset Leverage AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot and ChatGPT to accelerate development cycles and improve code quality Build strong working relationships across diverse teams while maintaining a clear focus on customer needs and product quality Essential Requirements Hands-on experience in C#, .NET, and SQL with a proven ability to develop and test Microsoft Windows-based software systems Expertise in Test Driven Development (TDD) and Continuous Integration (CI) practices Familiarity with Agile development methodologies Proficiency in AI-assisted rapid software development using tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar AI coding assistants Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or equivalent; Master's Degree in Computer Science is a plus Desired Skills and Competencies Impact – Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent judgment; able to assess complex challenges and deliver meaningful, results-driven solutions Trust – Excellent written and verbal communication in English with the ability to build strong, trusted relationships across a diverse group of colleagues and customers Aspiration – Quality and teamwork oriented with a customer-first mindset, consistently striving to raise the bar on software standards and personal growth Curiosity – Openness to emerging technologies, particularly AI-assisted development tools, with a passion for exploring new ways to improve development speed and code quality R&D at AVEVA Our global team of 2000+ developers work on an incredibly diverse portfolio of over 75 industrial automation and engineering products, which cover everything from data management to 3D design. AI and cloud are at the centre of our strategy, and we have over 150 patents to our name. Our track record of innovation is no fluke – it’s the result of a structured and deliberate focus on learning, collaboration and inclusivity. If you want to build applications that solve big problems, join us. matches.title: Software Security Engineer
matches.text: Overview This is more than a job. It's a chance to build, grow, and make a real impact! Join our team as our new Software Security Engineer The Software Security Engineer is a member of the Software Security Group (SSG) in the R&D Department, a global group that focuses on supporting the delivery of secure products and services in cloud native and on-premises applications that serve numerous industries worldwide. The Software Security Engineer provides support to 74Software entities in the application of the Secure Software Development Lifecyle (SSDLC) for our products and services. This position will have primary responsibility for driving and continuously improving the SSDLC program, which includes performing security reviews, vulnerability assessments and guidance on the remediation/mitigation of security findings. This may also include designing and supporting security controls, optimizing our use of security testing suites, providing training in secure coding, and evangelizing security best practices within 74Software. The Software Security Group utilizes a structured approach for reviewing and validating the security of our software products with a mix of the following tools and processes: threat modeling, static source code analysis, dynamic analysis, attack surface analysis, software composition analysis, software vulnerability monitoring & management, manual penetration testing, third party penetration testing management, developer training in secure coding practices, and development/management of secure frameworks. Location: Noida Responsibilities Understanding of software security threats, mitigating controls, as well as their applicability to cloud and on-premises environments; Ability to learn new products and technical concepts quickly; Successfully manage time and technical responsibilities, set accurate expectations, and meet deliverable deadlines while working in a team environment; Strong communication skills and ability to understand challenges and problems facing engineering teams; Guide developers on the implementation of our SSDLC program which includes secure coding practices and processes, as well as secure architecture and secure software designs (Threat Modeling); Support teams in applying security within the CI/CD/CD process (DevSecOps); Support customers, developers and SSG in technical analysis of tool outputs; Support the management, control and upgrade of selected SSDLC tool suites. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or related field/equivalent experience; 1-2 years of supporting an SSDLC program or similar secure software activities; 4+ years relevant information technology or development experience; Hands-on experience in some of the following areas: threat modeling, dynamic and static analysis, attack surface analysis, software composition analysis, penetration testing, vulnerability remediation techniques, HTTP, XML, REST, C/C++, Java, Web Servers (Apache/IIS), Scripting languages (JavaScript, Python, node.js, etc.); Experience using productivity and communication suite tools to create documents, presentations, and detailed drawings; Experience in using ticketing and content management tools; Technical writing, documentation, and communication skills are required; Helpful Skills to Support the Responsibilities: Experience in Secure Code Analysis; Strong technical understanding and aptitude for analytical problem-solving; Understanding of CVSS, CWE, OWASP, ASVS and SANS top 25; Knowledge of penetration testing methodologies or experience performing software/application penetration testing; Working knowledge of Crypto technologies and practices (PKI, Crypto libraries, TLS/SSL etc.); Authentication and Authorization mechanics and protocols; Experience with Infrastructure as Code; Understanding of the system hardening processes, tools, guidelines and benchmarks; Understanding of enterprise computing environments, distributed applications, and an understanding of TCP/IP networks; Comfortable working on both Linux-based and MS Windows-based system platforms; Understanding and experience in IH/IR; Secure system configuration and deployment of infrastructure; Company Overview Company Overview 74Software, affiliated with Axway and SBS, together, we deliver secure, mission-critical software that powers a data-driven world. Independently operated leaders with decades of proves expertise. From secure integration and API solutions to cloud-based banking platforms, we help global organizations and financial institutions thrive. For more than 25 years, Axway has helped major brands and government agencies worldwide with trusted solutions in Manager File Transfer (MFT), B2B integration, API's, and Financial Accounting Hub products. SBS empowers banks and financial institutions to reimagine the future with a composable, cloud-based architecture supporting deposits, lending, compliance, payments, consumer finance, and asset finance operations across the globe. Why 74Software? We celebrate diverse perspectives and experiences, knowing our people are our greatest strenght. Join us and be part of a team where you can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We offer benefits that support your health, growth, and lifestyle, so you can thrive at work and beyond, including health coverage, retirement plans, paid time off, flexible work, career development, competitive pay, and global culture perks. Equal Opportunity Employer We are committed to providing equal opportunities and ensuring a fair and inclusive recruitment process. We do not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, gender, sexual orientation, race, religion, or any other protected characteristic. #LI-AJ1

nearMatches.title: Data Integration Engineer
nearMatches.text: Overview 74Software is growing continuously and modernizing its data landscape to support a new go-to-market strategy and a new generation of products. We are seeking a versatile engineer to join the Information Systems team in a role that bridges the gap between Application Integration and Data Engineering . In this hybrid position, you will work in an international, multicultural environment. You will be responsible for connecting enterprise applications while simultaneously designing and maintaining robust data pipelines that power analytics, reporting, and AI. This is an opportunity to work with both established enterprise systems (Workday, Salesforce, ServiceNow) and modern cloud-native architectures (Snowflake, Airflow, dbt). Location: Sofia, Bulgaria Work model: Hybrid Responsibilities Data Engineering & Pipeline Development Develop, optimize, and manage ELT/ETL data pipelines using SQL, Python, and dbt. Build, schedule, and monitor data workflows using orchestration tools such as Airflow. Import data from various applications into the Snowflake-based data warehouse for reporting and data science purposes. Explore and participate in projects involving real-time data processing and advanced analytics. Data Modeling & Architecture Design and implement data models (e.g., dimensional, Data Vault) to support analytical, AI, and operational needs. Contribute to the evolution of the data lake and data warehouse architecture. Document data models, pipelines, and architecture to ensure operational clarity. Integration & Connectivity Connect different Information System applications, including Workday, Salesforce, and ServiceNow. Manage the technical implementation of data flows using tools such as Axway API Management, Amplify Fusion, Talend, Workday Studio, Python and JavaScript. Analyze requirements provided by business analysts to write technical specifications for integrations. Operations, Quality & Support Troubleshoot issues, identify root causes, and resolve bugs in new or existing implementations. Provide level 2 support on implementations. Support and enhance data governance, security, and data quality initiatives. Collaborate with business teams and analysts to deliver clean, trusted data for BI tools like Power BI. Qualifications Experience & Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field. 5+ years of experience in a similar role involving Application Integration, API/ETL Development, or Data Engineering. Professional working English. Technical Skills (Must-Have): Integration: Experience with API or ETL development (Talend or similar). Database: Advanced SQL skills for extraction, transformation, and analysis. Programming: Proficiency in Python for scripting and pipeline development, or good knowledge of JavaScript/Java. Data Modeling: Strong expertise in database design and modeling. Technical Skills (Preferred/Plus): Experience with Snowflake or other cloud data platforms (BigQuery, Redshift) regarding data ingestion and modeling. Knowledge of Salesforce and Workday (including Workday Studio). Familiarity with modern data stack tools: dbt for transformation and Airflow for orchestration. Knowledge of Axway API Management or Amplify Fusion. Exposure to Power BI , Microsoft Fabric, or Apache Spark. Methodology: Experience using Agile methodologies like Scrum and Kanban. Familiarity with Data Vault methodology. Why Join Us? Join a global team shaping the future of enterprise integration and data-driven decision-making. Work across modern and legacy systems, combining classic data engineering with cloud-native and real-time architectures. Be part of a supportive, collaborative culture where your growth is a shared success. Contribute to high-visibility projects that directly impact business outcomes for over 11,000 customers worldwide. Expand your expertise in data modeling, governance, cloud platforms, and advanced analytics. Company Overview 74Software, affiliated with Axway and SBS, together, we deliver secure, mission-critical software that powers a data-driven world. Independently operated leaders with decades of proven expertise. From secure integration and API solutions to cloud-based banking platforms, we help global organizations and financial institutions thrive. For more than 25 years, Axway has helped major brands and government agencies worldwide with trusted solutions in Managed File Transfer (MFT), B2B integration, APIs, and Financial Accounting Hub products. SBS empowers banks and financial institutions to reimagine the future with a composable, cloud-based architecture supporting deposits, lending, compliance, payments, consumer finance, and asset finance operations across the globe.
